items.title: 蘋果不必打造最強AI模型也能賺錢！分析師估AI每股價值75美元、目標價上看400美元
items.title_en: Apple Can Profit Without Building the Strongest AI Model! Analyst Values AI at $75 per Share, Target Price Up to $400
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US) 在生成式人工智慧（AI）競賽中未必需要打造全球最強大的模型，就有機會成為消費型AI浪潮的主要受益者。投資機構Wedbush分析師艾夫斯（Dan Ives）指出，蘋果真正的競爭優勢在於全球超過25億台活躍裝置所構成的龐大生態系，若能將AI功能轉化為服務營收的新成長動能，將為公司創造更多獲利機會。
根據《Benziga》報導，艾夫斯認為，投資人評估蘋果的AI布局時，不應只關注公司是否在模型開發競賽中落後，更重要的是，蘋果能否有效運用龐大的既有用戶基礎，將實用的AI功能帶進消費者的日常生活。
根據艾夫斯的估計，蘋果在全球擁有超過25億台活躍裝置，其中包括15億支iPhone。這代表蘋果已建立規模龐大的消費者通路，讓AI開發商難以輕易複製。
蘋果的策略是將裝置端運算、個人情境資訊、軟硬體整合及隱私保護結合，讓AI不再只是獨立運作的應用程式，而是融入整個蘋果產品與服務體驗。
艾夫斯因此形容，蘋果有機會成為「消費型AI高速公路上的收費站」，藉由既有裝置、作業系統及開發者生態系，在消費者使用AI的過程中取得商業價值。
這項策略意味著，蘋果不必在基礎模型能力上取得絕對領先，只要能讓用戶透過蘋果裝置持續使用AI，就有機會從相關服務中獲利。

AI有望推升服務營收　每股價值估達75美元

艾夫斯看好的另一項機會，是AI逐步進入健康、健身、金融、遊戲及日常生活等領域後，為蘋果服務事業帶來新的變現空間。
透過龐大的裝置用戶基礎，蘋果可以協助開發者觸及更多消費者，同時在既有服務生態系中創造新的營收來源。
艾夫斯估計，未來與AI相關的營收貢獻可能占蘋果服務事業營收逾15%，但他認為，華爾街目前尚未在蘋果的估值中充分反映這項潛力。
他進一步估算，蘋果的AI發展願景及商業化機會，可能為每股股票帶來約75美元的價值，並支撐其每股400美元的目標價。

iPhone換機潮與新機助攻　AI成長增添動能

除了服務營收的潛力，蘋果接下來的硬體產品週期也可能成為股價的重要催化劑。
艾夫斯估計，目前約有3.75億支iPhone使用超過4年仍未升級，形成可觀的潛在換機需求。
此外，他預期蘋果新款iPhone Duo在未來幾季的銷量可望達到約1,000萬支，若表現符合最樂觀情境，至年底假期購物季的銷量可能達到約1,500萬支。
艾夫斯將這款新裝置視為蘋果自AirPods問世以來，首項重大的新硬體創新，並認為這可能代表蘋果在執行長特納斯（John Ternus）領導下，迎來新一輪硬體產品週期。
這也讓蘋果面臨雙重成長機會：AI功能可望提高既有裝置生態系的價值，而使用年限較長的iPhone與新款摺疊裝置，則可能帶動消費者換機。
對投資人而言，接下來的關鍵在於，蘋果能否將AI從產品功能轉化為持續性的服務營收。如果艾夫斯的判斷正確，蘋果不需要打造整條消費型AI高速公路，只要掌握用戶入口，就有機會從中持續獲利。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) may not need to build the world’s most powerful generative AI model to become a major beneficiary of the consumer AI wave. Wedbush analyst Dan Ives says Apple’s real competitive edge lies in its massive ecosystem of over 2.5 billion active devices worldwide; turning AI features into service revenue could create new profit opportunities for the company.

Ives notes that investors evaluating Apple’s AI strategy should not focus solely on whether the company lags in model development, but rather on whether Apple can leverage its huge existing user base to bring practical AI functions into everyday consumer life.
Ives estimates Apple has more than 2.5 billion active devices globally, including 1.5 billion iPhones, giving Apple a massive consumer channel that AI developers will find hard to replicate.

Apple’s strategy combines on‑device computing, personal context data, tight hardware‑software integration and privacy protection, making AI not just a standalone app but embedded across Apple products and services.
Ives describes Apple as a potential “toll booth on the consumer‑AI highway,” capturing commercial value as users employ AI through Apple’s devices, operating system and developer ecosystem.
This approach means Apple doesn’t need to lead in foundational model capability; as long as users keep using AI on Apple hardware, the company can profit from related services.
AI is expected to boost service revenue, with an estimated per‑share value of $75.
Through its massive device base, Apple can help developers reach more consumers and create new revenue streams within its existing service ecosystem.
Ives projects AI‑related revenue could account for more than 15% of Apple’s services revenue, a potential that Wall Street has not yet fully priced in.
He further estimates Apple’s AI vision and commercialization could add roughly $75 per share and support a $400 target price per share.
iPhone upgrade cycle and new devices add momentum to AI growth.
Ives estimates about 375 million iPhones are over four years old and have not been upgraded, representing a sizable replacement demand.
He also expects the upcoming iPhone Duo to sell around 10 million units in the next few quarters, with an optimistic scenario reaching about 15 million units by the holiday season.
Ives sees the Duo as Apple’s most significant new hardware innovation since the launch of AirPods, signaling a new hardware cycle under CEO John Ternus.
This creates a dual growth opportunity: AI features can enhance the value of existing devices, while longer‑life iPhones and the new foldable device could drive upgrades.

For investors, the key will be whether Apple can turn AI from a product feature into recurring service revenue; if Ives is right, Apple need not build the entire consumer‑AI highway, just capture the user entry point to keep profiting.

items.title: 資深分析師大幅上調美光目標價 看好未來3至5年潛力
items.title_en: Senior Analyst Raises Micron Target Price Sharply, Bullish on 3-5 Year Potential
paras: 《TheStreet》報導，美光科技(Micron Technology)(MU-US)投資人今年已經獲得相當可觀報酬。如今更棘手問題是，AI是否已從根本上改變這家公司的業務，使這波漲勢不再只是熟悉的記憶體景氣循環又一次走向高峰。
這是個非常龐大的問題。如果需求維持緊俏的時間是以「年」而不是「季」計算，而且美光能夠透過長期協議鎖定更多業務，那麼這家公司可能開始不再像一家高度波動的商品型生產商，而更像一家擁有持續獲利能力的企業。
D.A. Davidson資深分析師Gil Luria認為，市場仍低估了這項轉變。他表示，「美光未來3到5年都處於成長軌道，這正是市場目前還沒有充分認知到的。」
他的投資論點建立在AI經濟模式的一項簡單轉變上。他預期供需將出現重大失衡，同時也向投資人提出一個更大的問題：美光的獲利是否仍應被視為暫時性的。
Luria認為，AI實際上已經把記憶體從高度周期性的商品，轉變為AI基礎設施中「任務關鍵」的元件。
因此，Luria將美光目標價從2,100美元大幅上調至3,000美元，並重申「買進」評級。美光周四收盤下跌4.7%，至每股1,035.84美元。
他認為美光正處於一段為期3至5年的成長軌道，而投資人尚未完全將這項成長潛力反映在股價估值中。他預期，記憶體需求在2027年與2028年都將超過供給。
他表示，投資人「才剛開始理解美光的價值」，並認為這個過程最終應會帶來明顯更高的本益比。
簡單來說，美光的投資論點其實很直接：能力更強大的AI系統，需要龐大數量的快速記憶體。
Luria的報告指出，增加記憶體容量可支援更大的上下文視窗、更快的處理速度，以及更佳的AI效能。這將改變記憶體的經濟價值，因為如果周邊系統無法快速向處理器提供足夠資料，GPU和客製化加速器就無法充分發揮作用。
美光也一直在提出幾乎相同的論點。據《路透社》報導，美光總裁兼營運長Manish Bhatia近期表示，隨著資料中心成為全球最大的記憶體與儲存市場，「記憶體已成為AI的主要瓶頸」。
此外，據《TrendForce》報導，美光預期2027與2028會計年度的記憶體供需狀況，將比2026會計年度更加吃緊。
支持Luria投資論點的數字也相當可觀。美光2026會計年度第四季營收從前一年度同期的113.2億美元，大幅成長至542.3億美元，調整後每股盈餘(EPS)達33.42美元。2026會計年度全年營收達1,331.9億美元，調整後每股盈餘為75.52美元。
管理層同時預估第一季營收約為615億美元，高於華爾街預期的570.2億美元。更重要的是，長期供應承諾從220億美元增加至320億美元，而剩餘履約義務從1,000億美元攀升至約1,500億美元。
這些數字支持Luria的看法，即長期合約可能讓美光過去高度周期性的業務變得更加可預測。即使「降規」也未必代表利空，因為如果減少記憶體用量最終會損害AI效能，反而可能促使客戶未來購買更多記憶體。
paras_en: TheStreet reports that Micron Technology (MU-US) investors have already enjoyed substantial returns this year. The tougher question now is whether AI has fundamentally altered the company’s business, turning this rally into more than just another peak in the familiar memory cycle.

This is a massive issue. If demand remains tight for years rather than quarters, and Micron can lock in more business through long‑term agreements, the company may start to look less like a highly volatile commodity producer and more like a firm with sustainable earnings power.

D.A. Davidson senior analyst Gil Luria believes the market still underestimates this shift. He says, “Micron will be on a growth trajectory for the next three to five years, something the market has not yet fully recognized.”

His investment thesis rests on a simple change in the AI economic model. He expects a major supply‑demand imbalance and poses a bigger question to investors: should Micron’s earnings still be viewed as temporary?
Luria argues that AI has already turned memory from a highly cyclical commodity into a “mission‑critical” component of AI infrastructure.
Accordingly, Luria lifted Micron’s price target from $2,100 to $3,000 and reaffirmed a “Buy” rating. Micron closed Thursday down 4.7% at $1,035.84 per share.
He sees Micron on a three‑to‑five‑year growth path that investors have not yet fully reflected in the stock’s valuation, forecasting memory demand to outpace supply in both 2027 and 2028.
Luria says investors are “just beginning to understand Micron’s value” and believes this realization will eventually drive a noticeably higher P/E multiple.
In short, the investment case for Micron is straightforward: more powerful AI systems require massive amounts of fast memory.

Luria’s report notes that larger memory capacity supports bigger context windows, faster processing speeds, and better AI performance. This changes the economics of memory because if surrounding systems cannot feed processors quickly enough, GPUs and custom accelerators cannot operate at full capacity.

Micron has been making a nearly identical argument. Reuters reports that Micron President and COO Manish Bhatia recently said that as data centers become the world’s largest memory and storage market, “memory has become the primary bottleneck for AI.”
Additionally, TrendForce reports that Micron expects the memory supply‑demand balance in fiscal 2027 and 2028 to be tighter than in fiscal 2026.

The numbers backing Luria’s thesis are substantial. Micron’s Q4 FY2026 revenue jumped from $11.32 billion a year earlier to $54.23 billion, with adjusted EPS of $33.42. Full‑year FY2026 revenue reached $133.19 billion, with adjusted EPS of $75.52.

Management also forecasts Q1 revenue around $61.5 billion, above Wall Street’s $57.02 billion estimate. More importantly, long‑term supply commitments rose from $22 billion to $32 billion, while remaining performance obligations climbed from $100 billion to roughly $150 billion.

These figures support Luria’s view that long‑term contracts could make Micron’s historically cyclical business more predictable. Even “down‑spec” moves may not be negative, because reducing memory usage could hurt AI performance and may actually prompt customers to buy more memory in the future.

items.title: 木頭姐最新持倉曝！大賣Meta、超微、Alphabet  斥670萬美元加碼「這一股」
paras: 「木頭姐」伍德（Cathie Wood）旗下方舟投資（ARK Invest）最新交易動向出爐，週四（8日）同步調節多檔科技股，賣出SpaceX(SPCX-US) 、Meta(META-US) 、超微半導體(AMD-US) 及Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 股票，並加碼國防科技公司Kratos Defense & Security Solutions Inc(KTOS-US)。
根據《Benziga》報導，其中，方舟投資透過旗下ARK Next Generation Technology ETF(ARKW-US) 賣出29,048股SpaceX股票，以當日收盤價160.57美元計算，交易金額約470萬美元；透過ARK 創新 ETF(ARKK-US) 賣出19,779股Meta股票，價值約1,430萬美元。
此外，方舟投資也透過ARKK賣出22,500股超微半導體股票，交易金額接近1,400萬美元，並賣出25,342股Alphabet C類股，價值約870萬美元。
相較之下，Kratos成為當日加碼標的。方舟投資透過ARKK買進159,918股Kratos股票，以當日收盤價41.93美元計算，交易金額約670萬美元。

SpaceX布局行動通訊　收購頻譜擴大Starlink野心

SpaceX週四宣布，已與Grain Management達成協議，將收購該公司在全美持有的800 MHz頻譜組合，但未公布交易金額。
這項交易將進一步推進SpaceX擴大Starlink Mobile業務、成為美國主要無線電信業者的計畫。
SpaceX表示，低頻頻譜有助於訊號穿透牆壁及其他障礙物，提升通訊覆蓋能力，但相關部署仍須取得美國聯邦通信委員會（FCC）最終批准。
SpaceX執行長馬斯克形容這項協議是「非常重大的交易」。投資人評估SpaceX可能帶來的競爭威脅後，AT&T(T-US) 、威瑞森電信(VZ-US) 及T-Mobile(TMUS-US) 股價在盤後交易中下跌。

Meta押注個人AI代理　商業化仍面臨挑戰

Meta的AI布局也受到市場關注。花旗預估，Meta推出的個人AI代理Muse到2030年每年可創造超過270億美元營收，其中約230億美元來自交易，另有約45億美元來自訂閱服務。
Muse自9月8日推出後，下載量已突破660萬次，每日活躍用戶達180萬人。不過，亞馬遜決定禁止Muse在其購物網站使用，也凸顯AI代理進軍電子商務市場仍可能面臨阻礙。
Meta預估，2026年資本支出將達1,300億至1,450億美元，以持續擴建AI基礎設施。

超微半導體提前布局2027年產能　Alphabet加速企業AI競爭

超微半導體執行長蘇姿丰本周稍早表示，隨著未來數年AI需求強勁，公司計畫在2027年大幅增加晶片供應。
超微半導體正與富士康、台積電(2330-TW) 及記憶體供應商合作，確保中央處理器（CPU）、圖形處理器（GPU）、先進晶圓及記憶體的產能。蘇姿丰指出，公司目前已提前3至5年規劃產能。
超微半導體資料中心事業主管Forrest Norrod則看好Venice系列CPU的發展機會，認為隨著AI代理普及，資料處理及工具使用相關工作負載的需求將增加。
Alphabet方面，Google推出可整合Gmail、Drive、Docs及Calendar的Gemini代理，進一步拓展企業AI服務。該工具能回答問題、建立內容及撰寫程式碼，並提供成本控管、安全及治理功能，瞄準企業客戶需求。
此舉也使Google與OpenAI、Anthropic、微軟及亞馬遜在企業AI市場的競爭更加激烈。另一方面，投資機構TD Cowen週四將Alphabet目標價上調至485美元，維持「買進」評等。

Kratos營收年增逾3成　全年財測同步上修

在方舟投資加碼的標的中，Kratos的最新財務表現值得關注。
Kratos於8月公布第二季財報，營收達4.588億美元，高於市場預估的4.1038億美元；調整後每股盈餘為0.21美元，也優於市場預期的0.14美元。營收年增30.5%，未交訂單金額達20.8億美元，另有150億美元的投標與提案機會。
公司並將全年營收預測從原先的17億至17.6億美元，上調至17.5億至18.1億美元。
執行長Eric DeMarco表示，業務動能預計將於2026年下半年持續加快，並延續至2027年。

其他重要交易：買進Genius Sports、Klarna與Archer Aviation

除上述主要持股調整外，方舟投資週四也進行多筆交易：

買進Genius Sports (GENI-US) ：透過ARK Fintech Innovation ETF（ARKF）買進347,777股。
買進Klarna Group Plc(KLAR-US) ：透過ARKF買進135,914股。
賣出DraftKings公司(DKNG-US) ：透過ARKF賣出106,134股。
賣出ARK 21Shares Bitcoin ETF(ARKB-US) ：透過ARKF賣出66,454股。
賣出Robinhood Markets(HOOD-US) ：透過ARKK賣出202,825股。
賣出Shopify公司(SHOP-US) ：透過ARKK賣出138,032股。
加碼Archer Aviation(ACHR-US) ：ARKK、ARKQ及ARKX合計買進148,928股。

items.title: 蘋果超薄機再進化！ iPhone Air 2傳厚度僅5.2mm 如同展開iPhone Duo
items.title_en: Apple's Ultra-Thin Phone Evolves Again! iPhone Air 2 Rumored to Be Only 5.2 mm Thick, Like an Unfolded iPhone Duo
paras: 多家外媒週四 (8 日) 報導，蘋果 (AAPL-US) 下一代超薄手機 iPhone Air 2 傳出將在機身進一步縮薄的同時，提高電池容量。最新爆料稱，新機厚度可能由初代的 5.6mm 降至約 5.2mm，減幅約 7%；先前傳聞則指出，電池容量將增至 3,500mAh，較現款增加約 11%。
韓國 Naver 部落格帳號「yeux1122」聲稱，iPhone Air 2 將借重 iPhone Duo 的部分工程技術，讓機身比現款薄約 0.4mm。
以蘋果公布的初代 iPhone Air 厚度計算，新機厚度將降至約 5.2mm，與 iPhone Duo 展開時相當。
除了機身厚度，電池設計也是此次爆料的焦點。
「yeux1122」稱，iPhone Air 2 將採用 Pro 機型使用的高密度電池，使新機在厚度縮減的情況下，仍能增加電池容量。
這項說法呼應先前有關 iPhone Air 2 電池升級的傳聞。
先前消息指出，新機將搭載 3,500mAh 電池，高於現款的 3,149mAh，容量增幅約為 11%。不過，目前尚無實際續航測試資料。
「yeux1122」過往對未發表產品的爆料準確度不一，此次涉及機身厚度與電池設計的資訊，尚未獲得其他消息來源佐證，相關規格仍待進一步確認。
依目前傳聞，iPhone Air 2 預計於 2027 年初推出，可能與標準版 iPhone 18、iPhone 18e 同步亮相，實際發表時間與產品規格仍待蘋果公布。
paras_en: Multiple foreign media outlets reported on Thursday (the 8th) that Apple (AAPL-US)’s next‑generation ultra‑thin phone, the iPhone Air 2, is said to become even slimmer while increasing battery capacity. The latest leak suggests the new device could shrink from the first‑gen 5.6 mm to about 5.2 mm, a reduction of roughly 7 %; earlier rumors indicated the battery would grow to 3,500 mAh, about an 11 % increase over the current model.
A Korean Naver blog account named “yeux1122” claims the iPhone Air 2 will borrow some engineering techniques from the iPhone Duo, making the body about 0.4 mm thinner than the current version.
Based on the thickness Apple disclosed for the first‑gen iPhone Air, the new model would drop to roughly 5.2 mm, comparable to the iPhone Duo when unfolded.
Beyond the chassis thickness, battery design is also a focal point of these leaks.
The “yeux1122” account says the iPhone Air 2 will use the high‑density battery found in the Pro models, allowing the device to gain capacity even as the thickness is reduced.
This claim echoes earlier rumors about a battery upgrade for the iPhone Air 2.
Previous reports indicated the new phone will house a 3,500 mAh battery, higher than the current 3,149 mAh, an increase of about 11 %; however, no actual endurance test data is available yet.

The “yeux1122” leaker has had mixed accuracy with unreleased products before, and the information about chassis thickness and battery design has not been corroborated by other sources, so the specifications remain to be confirmed.

According to current rumors, the iPhone Air 2 is expected to launch in early 2027, possibly alongside the standard iPhone 18 and iPhone 18e, but the exact announcement date and product specs are still pending Apple’s official disclosure.

items.title: 馬斯克放大招：Grok Bot免費用Opus 5.5和X全部功能！
items.title_en: Elon Musk Unleashes Major Update: Grok Bot Free with Opus 5.5 and Full X Features!
paras: 馬斯克旗下的 AI 服務 Grok Bot 傳出重大更新, 開始整合高階 AI 模型、X 平台資料存取及雲端代理人功能, 使用者不僅能透過自然語言指令交辦工作, 還可讓多個 AI 代理人分工協作, 在雲端持續執行程式開發、資訊監控與研究任務。
根據新智元2026年10月9日報導, Grok Bot 已可直接使用 Opus 5.5, 並整合 Midjourney、Suno 等服務, 同時提供 X 資料搜尋、閱讀及監控能力, 不必另外申請或支付 X API 費用。不過, 報導所述模型接入方式、免費使用條件及功能可用範圍, 仍應以官方公告與實際帳戶權限為準。

這次更新的核心是動態模型路由。使用者只需提出任務, Grok Bot 便會依照工作類型自動選擇合適的模型或 API, 不必自行判斷該使用哪一種工具。報導指出, 複雜程式架構與長篇文本推理可交由 Opus 5.5 處理, 專業視覺設計可調用 Midjourney, 音樂與配樂需求則可連接 Suno。至於 GPT-Image-2.5, 報導稱當時尚無法直接調用, 但 Grok Bot 本身具備圖像生成能力。
報導列出的 Opus 5.5 API 價格為每百萬輸入 Token 4美元、每百萬輸出 Token 20美元。若 Grok Bot 確實能在不另收模型 API 費用的情況下提供這項模型, 便可能降低使用者體驗高階模型的門檻, 但也意味平台必須承擔推理成本。報導引述業界看法指出, 這類免費接入可能是早期擴大用戶規模的策略, 若使用量快速增加, 平台未來可能調整模型路由、使用額度或免費方案條件。
Grok Bot 團隊成員 Lauren 先前曾表示, Bot 本身將直接運行在 Opus 5.5 上, 並已開始分批推出。使用者也可透過 Bot 建立 Cloud Agents, 由主代理人負責拆解及統籌任務, 子代理人則利用 Cursor 支援的模型分頭執行, 形成多代理人協作流程。
報導提及, SpaceXAI 產品負責人 Akshaya 曾分享內部使用經驗。她表示, 團隊已使用 Opus 5.5 一段時間, 效果令人驚艷。在一次客戶通話中, 她提出一項功能需求後, Bot 幾秒內便產出完整產品需求文件, Cloud Agent 隨即開始開發, 最後連準備合併的程式碼變更請求 (PR) 都已完成, 展現從需求整理到程式開發的自動化流程。
另一個應用案例是名為 Pulse 的自動化機器人。使用者利用 Grok Bot 每小時讀取自己在 X 上收到的提及 (mentions), 過濾垃圾訊息與空泛留言, 再整理出需要回覆的問題、客戶回饋、錯誤回報、PR 及功能需求。遇到複雜問題時, 系統再由 Opus 5.5 接手推理, 讓日常監控與深度分析分別由不同模型負責。

報導也提到, 有使用者利用 Grok Bot、Opus 5.5 與 Cursor Agents 建立全天候量化研究團隊, 將工作拆分為總控、市場情報、策略研究、策略驗證、風險控制、投資組合建議及執行等角色。各代理人透過 Cloud Agents 協作, Opus 5.5 負責複雜推理與程式碼生成, Cursor Agents 則負責實際建置與回測, 形成24小時自動化研究流程。不過, 報導並未提供這套系統的實際投資績效或風險調整後報酬數據, 因此不能據此判定其投資成果。
除了模型整合, Grok Bot 另一項更新是原生接入 X 的資料。根據報導, 使用者不必另外申請或支付昂貴的 API 費用, 就能讓代理人搜尋、閱讀並持續監控大量貼文, 還能建立名為 Routines 的自動化任務, 讓工作在背景持續運行, 再將結果推送給使用者。
報導整理出七種商業應用方向, 包括自動製作產業晨報、尋找競爭對手的核心用戶、轉化既有公域流量、即時捕捉購買意圖、全天候監測品牌與口碑、在銷售拜訪前快速蒐集客戶背景, 以及分析熱門內容的製作方式。這些用途的共同點, 是讓 AI 不只回答單次問題, 還能持續追蹤公開資訊, 並依照預設條件整理出可採取行動的結果。
Grok Bot 與一般聊天機器人的另一項差異, 在於報導所描述的獨立雲端電腦環境。傳統在本機執行的開發工具, 可能因使用者關閉電腦而停止工作; Grok Bot 則透過雲端環境讓代理人持續執行任務, 使用者即使離線, 背景工作仍可繼續進行。這種設計有利於長時間資料蒐集、程式建置與定期報告, 但實際能否持續運作, 仍取決於服務可用性、帳戶權限、運算額度及使用者設定。
在使用介面方面, 報導指出, 有使用者 Kin 已將 Grok Bot 接入微信。其展示的設定流程包括在電腦端 Grok Bot 發出接入指令、建立專屬金鑰, 再透過掃碼完成綁定, 全程約需5分鐘。接入後, 微信訊息可轉交給 Grok Bot 處理, 讓使用者直接在熟悉的通訊軟體中指揮 AI 代理人。這屬於報導中的使用者實作案例, 並不代表該整合是官方推出、所有帳戶均可使用或已獲微信正式支援。
報導還展示以 Opus 5.5 製作30秒 Grok Bot 介紹影片的案例, 並提及作者透過一項名為「Tibo 測試」的測試, 嘗試確認系統是否確實路由至最新模型。這些展示反映多模型路由與自動化工作流程的潛在用途, 但單一測試或示範並不足以獨立證明所有請求都會使用特定模型。
整體而言, Grok Bot 這波更新將高階模型路由、X 資料存取、雲端代理人及自動化任務整合到同一工作流程, 讓使用者有機會以單一介面完成從資訊蒐集、內容整理到程式開發的多階段工作。若免費接入與自動路由功能能持續提供, 將可能降低個人開發者與小型團隊使用多種 AI 工具的成本; 但免費政策能否長期維持、模型可用範圍是否調整, 以及資料權限與自動化執行的安全性, 仍是後續觀察重點。
paras_en: Musk’s AI service Grok Bot announced a major update, beginning to integrate advanced AI models, X platform data access, and cloud‑agent capabilities. Users can not only issue tasks via natural‑language commands, but also let multiple AI agents collaborate, continuously executing software development, information monitoring, and research tasks in the cloud.

According to a report by New Knowledge on October 9, 2026, Grok Bot can now use Opus 5.5 directly and integrates services such as Midjourney and Suno, while also providing X data search, reading, and monitoring abilities without requiring separate applications or paying X API fees. However, the reported model‑access method, free‑use conditions, and functional scope should still be confirmed against official announcements and actual account permissions.

The core of this update is dynamic model routing. Users simply state a task, and Grok Bot automatically selects the appropriate model or API based on the work type, eliminating the need for users to decide which tool to use. The report notes that complex code architectures and long‑form reasoning can be handled by Opus 5.5, professional visual design can call Midjourney, and music or scoring needs can connect to Suno. As for GPT‑Image‑2.5, the report says it cannot yet be invoked directly, though Grok Bot itself has image‑generation capability.

The report lists Opus 5.5 API pricing at $4 per million input tokens and $20 per million output tokens. If Grok Bot truly offers this model without charging separate model‑API fees, it could lower the barrier for users to experience high‑end models, but it also means the platform must bear inference costs. Industry commentary cited in the article suggests that such free access may be an early‑stage strategy to grow the user base; if usage spikes, the platform may later adjust model routing, usage limits, or free‑plan conditions.

Team member Lauren previously said the Bot will run directly on Opus 5.5 and has already begun rolling out in batches. Users can also create Cloud Agents through the Bot; a primary agent breaks down and coordinates tasks, while subsidiary agents use models supported by Cursor to execute parts of the work, forming a multi‑agent collaboration workflow.

The article mentions SpaceXAI product lead Akshaya sharing internal experience. She said the team has been using Opus 5.5 for a while with impressive results. In a client call, after she submitted a feature request, the Bot produced a complete product‑requirements document within seconds, a Cloud Agent immediately started development, and even the code‑change pull request for merging was completed, demonstrating an end‑to‑end automation from requirement gathering to code development.

Another use case is an automation robot called Pulse. Users have Grok Bot read their X mentions each hour, filter spam and vague comments, and then compile questions needing replies, customer feedback, bug reports, PRs, and feature requests. For complex issues, the system hands the reasoning over to Opus 5.5, allowing routine monitoring and deep analysis to be handled by different models.

The report also notes that some users have built a 24‑hour quantitative research team using Grok Bot, Opus 5.5, and Cursor Agents, breaking work into roles such as central control, market intelligence, strategy research, strategy validation, risk control, portfolio recommendation, and execution. Agents collaborate via Cloud Agents, with Opus 5.5 handling complex reasoning and code generation, while Cursor Agents perform implementation and back‑testing, creating a continuous automated research pipeline. However, the article provides no actual investment performance or risk‑adjusted return data, so outcomes cannot be assessed.

Beyond model integration, another Grok Bot update is native X data access. According to the report, users can let agents search, read, and continuously monitor large volumes of posts without applying for or paying expensive API fees, and can create automated tasks called Routines that run in the background and push results to users.

The report outlines seven commercial application directions: automatically generating industry morning briefs, identifying core users of competitors, converting existing public‑traffic, capturing purchase intent in real time, 24‑hour brand and sentiment monitoring, quickly gathering client backgrounds before sales visits, and analyzing how popular content is produced. The common thread is that AI not only answers single questions but continuously tracks public information and, based on preset conditions, organizes actionable results.

A key difference between Grok Bot and typical chatbots, as described in the report, is its independent cloud‑computer environment. Traditional development tools run locally and stop when the user shuts down their machine; Grok Bot’s cloud environment lets agents keep working offline, allowing long‑running data collection, code building, and periodic reporting. Whether this can truly run continuously depends on service availability, account permissions, compute quotas, and user settings.

In terms of interface, the report notes a user named Kin who integrated Grok Bot with WeChat. The setup process involved issuing an integration command from the desktop Grok Bot, generating a dedicated key, and completing binding via QR‑code scan, taking about five minutes. After integration, WeChat messages are forwarded to Grok Bot for handling, letting users command AI agents within a familiar messaging app. This is a user‑implemented example and does not imply official support, universal availability, or WeChat endorsement.

The report also showcases a 30‑second Grok Bot introduction video created with Opus 5.5 and mentions the author’s “Tibo test” to verify that the system routes requests to the latest model. These demos illustrate potential uses of multi‑model routing and automated workflows, but a single test or demonstration cannot independently prove that all requests will use a specific model.

Overall, this wave of Grok Bot updates integrates high‑end model routing, X data access, cloud agents, and automated tasks into a single workflow, giving users the chance to complete multi‑stage work—from information gathering and content organization to code development—through one interface. If free access and automatic routing persist, they could lower costs for individual developers and small teams using multiple AI tools; however, the longevity of the free policy, possible adjustments to model availability, and the security of data permissions and automated execution remain key points to watch.

items.title: AI生產力效益還沒現身「沒關係」？《巴隆》龐大資本支出撐起美國經濟、股市先受惠
paras: 人工智慧（AI）能否真正提升企業生產力，至今仍有待數據驗證，但在效益兌現之前，科技業大舉投入的資本支出，已先為美國經濟注入成長動能。從運算設備、軟體到資料中心，AI建設熱潮帶動相關投資持續擴大，或成為今年美國經濟成長的重要支柱。
根據《巴隆周刊》報導，企業投入數十億美元發展AI，期待透過自動化與流程最佳化，讓更少員工完成更多工作，降低營運成本、減少浪費，最終推升企業獲利並帶動整體經濟。
然而，這些效益究竟何時才能充分展現，目前仍存在不確定性。
荷蘭國際集團（ING）首席國際經濟學家James Knightley估計，2026年AI相關投資將貢獻美國約三分之一的經濟成長，涵蓋運算設備、軟體及資料中心等多個領域。
這項估計與聖路易聯準銀行經濟學家今年1月公布的分析大致相符。該研究指出，2025年第三季，資訊處理設備、軟體、研發及資料中心等AI相關類別，合計占美國國內生產毛額（GDP）成長的39%。
除了大型科技企業持續加碼，政府也開始投入更多資源。今年春季，美國國防部提議在2027財政年度為新成立的「AI軍火庫」計畫編列近300億美元，用於建置政府所有的AI基礎設施。
不過，AI建設熱潮對經濟的影響並非全然正面。大規模投資也推升成本與物價，影響範圍不僅限於科技產業。根據消費者物價指數（CPI）數據，8 月電價年增了 3.8%。

AI投資規模驚人　生產力數據卻尚未出現明顯突破

儘管資金大量湧入AI領域，企業期待的生產力提升仍未在關鍵數據中明確顯現。
阿波羅全球管理公司（Apollo Global Management）首席經濟學家Torsten Slok認為，全要素生產力（TFP）是衡量技術進步最接近的指標。
美國勞工統計局指出，TFP反映在不增加投入的情況下，經濟能夠生產多少產出；這些投入包括勞工工時增加或新增機器設備。
Slok指出，從這項指標來看，AI目前尚未帶來顯著改善。部分企業的產出增加，實際上可能來自投入更多設備與工時，而非技術本身大幅提升效率。
他引述舊金山聯準銀行的分析指出，自AI資本支出週期啟動以來，經過設備使用率調整的全要素生產力，仍未出現加速成長的跡象，目前數值略低於零。
相較之下，美國每工時產出成長率接近2.5%，明顯高於2005年以來的平均水準，經常被視為AI已開始發揮作用的證據。
但Slok認為，每工時產出強勁、全要素生產力卻停滯的情況，更符合資本深化的特徵，也就是企業增加資本投入帶動產出，而非技術突破直接推升效率。
他總結，AI熱潮已清楚反映在投資數據與股市估值上，卻尚未出現在生產力統計中。因此，AI最終能帶來多少生產力效益，目前仍是預期，而非已經獲得數據證實的成果。
不過，過去的技術革新也曾需要一段時間，才能在經濟統計中顯現效果。

AI支出支撐經濟與股市　投資熱潮退去後成隱憂

《巴隆》指出，AI生產力效益尚未兌現，也讓投資人開始思考：當數十億甚至數千億美元的基礎建設資金逐步投入後，還有什麼力量能繼續支撐美國經濟？
不過，Capital Economics經濟學家Paul Dales指出，即使考量物價上漲帶來的負面影響，龐大的AI投資本身仍有助於經濟成長。AI需求持續擴大，可能降低全球經濟陷入衰退的風險；若經濟能避免下滑，未來AI生產力提升帶來的效益也可能更早顯現。
股市則已率先受惠。標普500指數與那斯達克綜合指數本週雙雙再創歷史新高，而兩大指數2026年以來各自創下歷史新高的次數都已超過20次，AI交易熱潮是推升行情的重要力量。
整體而言，AI目前對經濟的主要貢獻仍來自建設階段的資本支出，而非已獲證實的生產力突破。只要相關投資能持續支撐經濟成長，就有機會讓經濟更平穩地過渡到AI真正開始顯著提升生產力的階段。

items.title: AI泡沫誰來戳破？ 達里歐示警：富豪變現壓力或成引爆點
items.title_en: Who Will Burst the AI Bubble? Dalio Warns Wealth‑Realisation Pressure Could Be the Trigger
paras: 橋水基金創辦人達里歐 (Ray Dalio) 警告，人工智慧 (AI) 投機熱潮可能正接近泡沫破裂的階段。他指出，富豪帳面上的資產價值不等於可動用的現金，若財富稅等措施迫使持有人出售資產，可能加速或促成泡沫破裂。
達里歐週三 (7 日) 在新加坡舉行的富比士全球執行長會議上表示，市場仍處於泡沫破裂前的階段，但已逐漸逼近轉折點。他說：「我認為我們已經很接近了。」
達里歐將焦點放在帳面財富與現金之間的差異。
他指出，即使有人自稱身價達 10 億美元，也不代表能直接花用這筆錢；要取得可支用的資金，必須先出售資產，而這類變現壓力往往可能成為刺破泡沫的因素。
他認為，財富稅等迫使超級富豪將未實現收益變現的措施，可能加快這個過程。不過，他並未提出泡沫破裂的具體時間表。
與此同時，美股權重高度集中於少數科技巨頭，也讓 AI 行情的風險受到關注。
Creative Planning 數據顯示，輝達 (NVDA-US)、蘋果 (AAPL-US) 與微軟 (MSFT-US) 合計占 S&P 500 指數權重逾 21%，創下該指數前三大成分股集中度的新高。
相較之下，1980 年代中期，IBM (IBM-US)、AT&T (T-US) 與埃克森美孚 (XOM-US) 合計占 S&P 500 指數的權重，在高峰時為 13.4%。
如今前三大科技股的權重更高，也意味這些公司的股價變化，對大盤走勢具有更大的影響力。
paras_en: Bridgewater founder Ray Dalio warned that the AI speculation frenzy may be nearing a bubble burst. He noted that the paper value of wealthy individuals' assets does not equal cash on hand, and if wealth taxes or similar measures force holders to sell assets, it could accelerate or cause the bubble to pop.

Dalio said on Wednesday (the 7th) at the Forbes Global CEO Conference in Singapore that the market is still in the pre‑burst phase but is gradually approaching a turning point. He added, "I think we are very close."
Dalio focused on the gap between book wealth and cash.

He pointed out that even if someone claims a net worth of $1 billion, it does not mean they can spend that money directly; to obtain spendable cash they must first sell assets, and this realisation pressure can often become the factor that punctures the bubble.

He believes that measures such as wealth taxes that force ultra‑rich individuals to realise unrealised gains could speed up this process, though he did not give a specific timeline for a bubble burst.
At the same time, the heavy concentration of U.S. equities in a few tech giants has drawn attention to the risks in the AI rally.

Data from Creative Planning show that Nvidia (NVDA-US), Apple (AAPL-US) and Microsoft (MSFT-US) together account for more than 21% of the S&P 500 index weight, a new high for the top three constituents.
By contrast, in the mid‑1980s IBM (IBM-US), AT&T (T-US) and Exxon Mobil (XOM-US) together made up 13.4% of the S&P 500 at their peak.
The higher weight of today’s top three tech stocks means that price movements in these companies have an even larger impact on the overall market trend.

items.title: SpaceX買頻譜搶攻行動通訊美三大電信股盤後跌約6%
items.title_en: SpaceX Buys Spectrum to Attack Mobile Communications, U.S. Big Three Telecom Stocks Fall About 6% After Hours
paras: 2026年10月09日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ SpaceX於10月8日宣布，將向Grain Management收購涵蓋美國全國的800MHz頻譜使用權，取得最多14MHz的成對頻譜。雙方尚未公布交易金額，華爾街日報指出，SpaceX將支付約80億美元現金，交易仍待美國聯邦通訊委員會（FCC）核准。
這筆收購主要是為了改善Starlink Mobile的訊號涵蓋與室內收訊。手機直連衛星雖然能補足偏遠地區的通訊需求，但訊號進入建築物後，連線品質仍受到限制。800MHz屬於低頻頻段，訊號傳播距離較遠，穿透牆面與樹木的能力也較好。SpaceX計畫結合地面行動網路與衛星服務，提高不同使用環境下的連線穩定度。
SpaceX的衛星布局也有進展。FCC本週核准其部署最多1.5萬顆支援手機直連的衛星，為Starlink Mobile擴大服務規模鋪路。這項許可與800MHz頻譜收購案分別審查，後續仍須配合衛星發射與地面網路建置，才能逐步擴大服務範圍。
消息公布後，美國三大電信商T-Mobile(TMUS-US)、Verizon(VZ-US)與AT&T(T-US)盤後股價各跌約6%，反映市場對新增競爭者的疑慮。Verizon則表示，取得頻譜只是其中一步，SpaceX仍需要建置能實際提供服務的網路。

paras_en: On October 8, SpaceX announced that it will acquire from Grain Management the rights to use 800 MHz spectrum covering the entire United States, obtaining up to 14 MHz of paired spectrum. The parties have not disclosed the transaction amount, but the Wall Street Journal reports that SpaceX will pay roughly $8 billion in cash, and the deal still requires approval from the Federal Communications Commission (FCC).

The acquisition is mainly aimed at improving signal coverage and indoor reception for Starlink Mobile. Direct satellite-to‑phone links can fill communication gaps in remote areas, but once the signal enters a building the connection quality remains limited. The 800 MHz band is a low‑frequency range that propagates farther and penetrates walls and foliage better. SpaceX plans to combine ground‑based mobile networks with satellite service to boost connection stability across different usage environments.

SpaceX’s satellite deployment is also progressing. The FCC this week approved the launch of up to 15,000 satellites capable of direct phone connectivity, paving the way for a larger Starlink Mobile service footprint. This permission is reviewed separately from the 800 MHz spectrum purchase, and further satellite launches and ground‑network construction will be needed to gradually expand the service area.

After the news broke, the after‑hours share prices of the three major U.S. telecom operators—T‑Mobile (TMUS‑US), Verizon (VZ‑US) and AT&T (T‑US)—each fell about 6%, reflecting market concerns about a new competitor. Verizon said that acquiring spectrum is only one step and that SpaceX still needs to build a network that can actually deliver service.

items.title: OpenAI營收預期落差引發AI投資疑慮那指跌1.25%、半導體ETF跌2.8%
items.title_en: OpenAI Revenue Forecast Gap Raises AI Investment Concerns; Nasdaq Down 1.25%, Semiconductor ETF Down 2.8%
paras: 2026年10月09日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ AI營收成長能否支撐龐大資本支出，再度成為美股焦點。美股8日科技股承壓，那斯達克指數下跌1.25%，標普500指數跌0.5%，道瓊指數則小漲0.1%，賣壓主要集中在半導體與AI基礎建設族群。
根據金融時報報導，OpenAI近期向投資人提出的年化營收預估約500億美元，低於先前市場傳出的700億美元。雖然700億美元這個標準來自於市場自行的推估，並非公司正式財測，仍導致市場重新檢視AI需求，以及資料中心持續大舉投資的回收能力。
半導體族群跌勢較重，VanEck半導體ETF(SMH-US)下跌2.8%，Nebius(NBIS-US)、Bloom Energy(BE-US)與Astera Labs(ALAB-US)等AI相關個股也遭到賣壓。能源與金融股則逆勢走高，能源類股ETF上漲3%，標普500等權重ETF也漲0.6%，顯示市場跌勢並未全面擴散。
美債殖利率回落，提供其他類股支撐。美國10年期公債殖利率由盤前一度觸及的5.35%，降至5.23%；西德州原油雖從盤中高點拉回，收盤仍上漲3.6%，每桶報91.49美元。
盤後另一項焦點是SpaceX宣布收購800MHz頻譜，擴大Starlink Mobile布局。市場擔憂行動通訊競爭加劇，Verizon(VZ-US)、AT&T(T-US)與T-Mobile(TMUS-US)盤後各跌約6%，衛星通訊業者AST SpaceMobile(ASTS-US)也跌逾3%。
台灣時間9日上午，美股期指小幅回升，道瓊期指漲0.2%、標普500期指漲0.25%，那斯達克100期指漲0.35%。

paras_en: October 9, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center reporting) – Whether AI revenue growth can support massive capital spending is once again a focus for U.S. equities. On the 8th, technology stocks were under pressure, with the Nasdaq falling 1.25%, the S&P 500 down 0.5%, and the Dow Jones edging up 0.1%. Selling pressure was concentrated in semiconductor and AI infrastructure groups.

According to the Financial Times, OpenAI recently gave investors an annual revenue estimate of about $50 billion, lower than the previously circulated market estimate of $70 billion. Although the $70 billion figure originated from market speculation rather than an official company forecast, it has prompted the market to reassess AI demand and the recoverability of the massive data‑center investment wave.

The semiconductor sector fell harder, with the VanEck Semiconductor ETF (SMH‑US) down 2.8%. AI‑related stocks such as Nebius (NBIS‑US), Bloom Energy (BE‑US) and Astera Labs (ALAB‑US) also faced selling pressure. Energy and financial stocks moved higher against the trend, with an energy‑sector ETF up 3% and the equal‑weight S&P 500 ETF gaining 0.6%, indicating that the market decline was not universal.

U.S. Treasury yields retreated, providing support to other sectors. The 10‑year Treasury yield fell from a pre‑market high of 5.35% to 5.23%. West Texas Intermediate crude oil pulled back from its intraday peak but still closed up 3.6% at $91.49 per barrel.

After hours, another focus was SpaceX’s announcement that it is acquiring 800 MHz of spectrum to expand its Starlink Mobile footprint. The market worries that mobile‑communication competition will intensify, sending Verizon (VZ‑US), AT&T (T‑US) and T‑Mobile (TMUS‑US) down about 6% each after hours, while satellite‑communication operator AST SpaceMobile (ASTS‑US) fell more than 3%.

items.title: 紐約Fed：川普關稅推升美國消費品通膨2.9個百分點 物價壓力恐延續一年
items.title_en: New York Fed: Trump Tariffs Boost U.S. Consumer Goods Inflation by 2.9 Percentage Points, Price Pressure May Last a Year
paras: 美國聯邦準備銀行紐約分行最新研究指出, 美國總統川普推動的關稅政策已明顯推高美國消費品價格, 截至2026年2月, 關稅估計使消費品價格通膨增加2.9個百分點。
研究顯示, 關稅成本不只反映在進口商品, 也會透過原料成本上升及競爭減弱, 推高美國國內製造商品價格。即使部分關稅措施後來遭到調整, 先前累積的成本仍會持續影響價格, 而完整衝擊可能需要約一年才會顯現。

紐約聯準銀行研究人員 Mary Amiti、Sebastian Heise, 以及哥倫比亞大學經濟學教授 David E. Weinstein 在10月6日發布的研究中, 分析2025至2026年關稅對消費品零售價格的影響。研究比較67類非石油消費品中, 關稅曝險程度較高與較低的商品價格變化, 並將服務排除在樣本之外。服務約占美國消費支出籃子的三分之二, 因此這項研究衡量的是商品價格受到的關稅衝擊, 並非整體消費者物價指數 (CPI) 的全部變化。
研究估計, 平均關稅稅率每增加1個百分點, 一年後消費品價格約上升0.25%。若假設所有進口商品都被加徵10%關稅, 12個月後消費品價格將提高約2.6%。換言之, 關稅增加不會完全等比例反映在消費者最終支付的價格上, 但仍會透過供應鏈及零售環節逐步傳導。
關稅對價格的影響主要分為直接與間接兩個部分。直接影響來自進口商品價格上升, 約占總價格效應的三分之二; 間接影響則占約三分之一, 包括美國製造商因進口零組件及原料變貴而提高生產成本, 以及進口商品價格上升後, 國內競爭產品面臨的價格壓力減輕, 使業者有空間提高售價或加價幅度。
在直接傳導方面, 研究發現, 2025年關稅成本約有90%轉嫁至美國進口價格, 外國出口商並未大幅自行吸收關稅。進口價格通常在關稅調升後第一個月就接近等比例上升, 即使將美元貶值的影響納入考量, 結果仍大致相同。零售價格的反應則較慢, 因為商品還要經過運輸、批發及零售等環節。

研究估計, 當進口商品與美國國內生產商品的價格因關稅上漲10%時, 零售價格平均上升約5.6%。研究人員以一項零售價格100美元的商品為例, 假設其中50美元是進口或出廠價格, 另外50美元為物流、批發及零售等通路成本; 若前段商品成本上升10%至55美元, 而通路成本不變, 零售價格便會升至105美元, 漲幅約5%, 與研究估計的5.6%接近。這也說明, 關稅對零售價格的影響會受到商品成本結構及通路加價幅度左右。
至於美國國內製造商品, 關稅衝擊需要更長時間才會完整反映。研究發現, 關稅調升後的前6個月, 美國生產者價格僅小幅上升, 隨後6個月的價格反應則約增至先前的兩倍。由於企業需要逐步消化進口原料、零組件及其他投入成本, 國內商品價格的間接影響通常要在9至12個月後才會充分顯現。
根據研究估算, 截至2026年2月, 川普政府實施的關稅已使67類非石油消費品的價格通膨增加2.9個百分點。若沒有這些關稅影響, 相關商品價格原本可能略微下跌, 而不是繼續上漲。研究人員強調, 這項估算是控制匯率、工資、消費需求及貨幣政策等整體經濟因素後, 推算關稅對商品價格的額外影響, 並不代表所有同期通膨都由關稅造成。
研究也指出, 關稅對消費品價格水準的影響在2026年2月附近達到約3%, 之後逐步下降。研究預測, 到2026年8月, 關稅造成的商品價格水準增幅已降至約2%。這項回落主要與2026年初部分緊急權力關稅遭美國最高法院裁定失去法律依據後, 改由較低的10%附加關稅取代有關, 直接影響因此減弱; 但國內製造商的成本傳導較為緩慢, 間接效應仍持續存在。
不過, 關稅對通膨的貢獻下降, 不代表商品價格會回到原本水準。研究區分了價格水準與通膨率的差異: 即使關稅不再持續推高同比價格增幅, 過去已經形成的成本上升仍可能讓商品價格維持在較高位置。當2025年大幅調升關稅的影響逐漸退出年度比較基期, 關稅對同比商品通膨的貢獻可能降至接近零, 甚至短暫轉為負值, 但價格水準仍高於沒有關稅的情境。
展望後續, 紐約聯準銀行的預測假設關稅維持在2026年9月底的水準, 但納入2027年1月預定對加拿大汽車、卡車及汽車零組件加徵的關稅。研究預期, 2026年8月後, 關稅對消費品價格水準的影響可能再度略為增加, 一部分來自2026年8月對加拿大商品的關稅仍在逐步傳導, 另一部分則來自2027年加拿大汽車相關關稅調升。
整體而言, 研究認為關稅的完整價格效應比單看進口商品更廣泛, 約四分之一的關稅增幅最終會傳導至消費品價格, 而美國國內製造商品約占總價格效應的三分之一。這意味著, 即使進口關稅降低或部分措施被撤銷, 企業成本、供應鏈調整與國內定價策略仍可能使價格壓力延續數月。對政策制定者而言, 評估關稅的通膨影響不能只看實施當下, 也必須考量後續一年內逐步浮現的間接成本。
paras_en: The New York Federal Reserve’s latest research finds that President Trump’s tariff policy has clearly pushed up U.S. consumer‑goods prices, adding an estimated 2.9 percentage points to inflation in consumer‑goods prices by February 2026.

The study shows that tariff costs are not limited to imported goods; they also raise raw‑material costs and weaken competition, lifting prices of domestically produced goods. Even though some tariffs were later adjusted, the accumulated costs continue to affect prices, and the full impact may take about a year to materialise.

Researchers Mary Amiti and Sebastian Heise of the New York Fed, together with Columbia University economist David E. Weinstein, released a paper on October 6 analysing the effect of tariffs on retail prices of consumer goods for 2025‑2026. The analysis compares price changes for 67 non‑energy consumer‑goods categories with high versus low tariff exposure, excluding services, which account for roughly two‑thirds of U.S. consumer spending. Thus the study measures the tariff impact on goods prices, not the entire consumer‑price index (CPI).

The study estimates that a one‑percentage‑point increase in the average tariff rate raises consumer‑goods prices by about 0.25 % after one year. Assuming a uniform 10 % tariff on all imports, consumer‑goods prices would be roughly 2.6 % higher after twelve months. In other words, tariff hikes are not passed through to final consumer prices on a one‑to‑one basis, but they do filter through the supply chain and retail stages gradually.

Tariff effects on prices are split into direct and indirect components. Direct effects stem from higher import prices and account for about two‑thirds of the total price impact; indirect effects make up roughly one‑third and include higher production costs for U.S. manufacturers due to pricier imported components and raw materials, as well as reduced price pressure on domestic competitors after import prices rise, giving firms room to raise their own prices.

Regarding direct pass‑through, the research finds that about 90 % of the 2025 tariff cost is shifted to U.S. import prices, with foreign exporters absorbing little of the tariff themselves. Import prices typically rise almost proportionally in the first month after a tariff increase, and the result holds even after accounting for dollar depreciation. Retail prices react more slowly because goods must pass through transportation, wholesale and retail stages.

The authors estimate that when tariffs raise the price of imported goods and comparable domestically produced goods by 10 %, retail prices increase on average by about 5.6 %. Using a $100 retail‑price example—$50 of which is the import or ex‑factory cost and $50 is logistics, wholesale and retail margins—if the former rises 10 % to $55 while the latter stays unchanged, the retail price climbs to $105, a roughly 5 % increase, close to the 5.6 % estimate. This illustrates that the impact of tariffs on retail prices depends on cost structure and margin‑setting behavior.

For domestically produced goods, the tariff shock takes longer to fully show up. The study finds that in the first six months after a tariff hike, U.S. producer‑price indices rise only modestly, then double that pace in the following six months. Because firms need time to absorb higher costs for imported inputs, the indirect impact on domestic‑goods prices usually becomes fully apparent only after nine to twelve months.

According to the authors’ calculations, by February 2026 the Trump‑era tariffs have added 2.9 percentage points to inflation for the 67 non‑energy consumer‑goods categories. Without those tariffs, prices in the affected categories might have slipped slightly rather than continued to rise. The estimate controls for exchange rates, wages, demand and monetary policy, isolating the extra price effect of tariffs, and does not imply that all contemporaneous inflation was caused by tariffs.

The research also notes that the tariff‑induced rise in the level of consumer‑goods prices peaks at about 3 % around February 2026 and then gradually declines. By August 2026 the tariff‑related price level increase is projected to fall to roughly 2 %. This decline is mainly due to the U.S. Supreme Court striking down several emergency‑authority tariffs in early 2026, which were replaced by a lower 10 % additional tariff, weakening the direct effect; however, the slower transmission of costs to domestic manufacturers means the indirect effect persists.

Nevertheless, a falling tariff contribution to inflation does not mean prices will revert to pre‑tariff levels. The study distinguishes between price level and inflation rate: even if tariffs stop pushing year‑over‑year price growth, the higher cost base already built up can keep prices elevated. As the large 2025 tariff hikes drop out of the annual comparison base, the tariff’s contribution to year‑over‑year consumer‑goods inflation may approach zero—or even turn briefly negative—while price levels remain above the no‑tariff scenario.

Looking ahead, the New York Fed assumes tariffs stay at their September 2026 level but incorporates a planned tariff on Canadian automobiles, trucks and auto parts slated for January 2027. The authors expect that after August 2026 the tariff’s impact on consumer‑goods price levels may rise again slightly, partly as the August 2026 Canadian‑goods tariff continues to work its way through the supply chain and partly due to the upcoming 2027 Canadian auto‑tariff increase.

Overall, the study concludes that the full price effect of tariffs is broader than the impact on imported goods alone: about one‑quarter of the tariff increase ultimately passes through to consumer‑goods prices, while domestically produced goods account for roughly one‑third of the total price effect. This means that even if import tariffs are reduced or some measures are rolled back, corporate costs, supply‑chain adjustments and domestic pricing strategies can keep price pressure alive for months. Policymakers therefore need to assess tariff‑related inflation not only at the moment of implementation but also over the ensuing year as indirect costs surface.

items.title: 蘋果不必打造最強AI模型也能賺錢！分析師估AI每股價值75美元、目標價上看400美元
items.title_en: Apple Can Profit Without Building the Strongest AI Model! Analyst Values AI at $75 per Share, Target Price Up to $400
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US) 在生成式人工智慧（AI）競賽中未必需要打造全球最強大的模型，就有機會成為消費型AI浪潮的主要受益者。投資機構Wedbush分析師艾夫斯（Dan Ives）指出，蘋果真正的競爭優勢在於全球超過25億台活躍裝置所構成的龐大生態系，若能將AI功能轉化為服務營收的新成長動能，將為公司創造更多獲利機會。
根據《Benziga》報導，艾夫斯認為，投資人評估蘋果的AI布局時，不應只關注公司是否在模型開發競賽中落後，更重要的是，蘋果能否有效運用龐大的既有用戶基礎，將實用的AI功能帶進消費者的日常生活。
根據艾夫斯的估計，蘋果在全球擁有超過25億台活躍裝置，其中包括15億支iPhone。這代表蘋果已建立規模龐大的消費者通路，讓AI開發商難以輕易複製。
蘋果的策略是將裝置端運算、個人情境資訊、軟硬體整合及隱私保護結合，讓AI不再只是獨立運作的應用程式，而是融入整個蘋果產品與服務體驗。
艾夫斯因此形容，蘋果有機會成為「消費型AI高速公路上的收費站」，藉由既有裝置、作業系統及開發者生態系，在消費者使用AI的過程中取得商業價值。
這項策略意味著，蘋果不必在基礎模型能力上取得絕對領先，只要能讓用戶透過蘋果裝置持續使用AI，就有機會從相關服務中獲利。

AI有望推升服務營收　每股價值估達75美元

艾夫斯看好的另一項機會，是AI逐步進入健康、健身、金融、遊戲及日常生活等領域後，為蘋果服務事業帶來新的變現空間。
透過龐大的裝置用戶基礎，蘋果可以協助開發者觸及更多消費者，同時在既有服務生態系中創造新的營收來源。
艾夫斯估計，未來與AI相關的營收貢獻可能占蘋果服務事業營收逾15%，但他認為，華爾街目前尚未在蘋果的估值中充分反映這項潛力。
他進一步估算，蘋果的AI發展願景及商業化機會，可能為每股股票帶來約75美元的價值，並支撐其每股400美元的目標價。

iPhone換機潮與新機助攻　AI成長增添動能

除了服務營收的潛力，蘋果接下來的硬體產品週期也可能成為股價的重要催化劑。
艾夫斯估計，目前約有3.75億支iPhone使用超過4年仍未升級，形成可觀的潛在換機需求。
此外，他預期蘋果新款iPhone Duo在未來幾季的銷量可望達到約1,000萬支，若表現符合最樂觀情境，至年底假期購物季的銷量可能達到約1,500萬支。
艾夫斯將這款新裝置視為蘋果自AirPods問世以來，首項重大的新硬體創新，並認為這可能代表蘋果在執行長特納斯（John Ternus）領導下，迎來新一輪硬體產品週期。
這也讓蘋果面臨雙重成長機會：AI功能可望提高既有裝置生態系的價值，而使用年限較長的iPhone與新款摺疊裝置，則可能帶動消費者換機。
對投資人而言，接下來的關鍵在於，蘋果能否將AI從產品功能轉化為持續性的服務營收。如果艾夫斯的判斷正確，蘋果不需要打造整條消費型AI高速公路，只要掌握用戶入口，就有機會從中持續獲利。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) may not need to build the world’s most powerful generative AI model to become a major beneficiary of the consumer AI wave. Wedbush analyst Dan Ives says Apple’s real competitive edge lies in its massive ecosystem of over 2.5 billion active devices worldwide; turning AI features into service revenue could create new profit opportunities for the company.

Ives notes that investors evaluating Apple’s AI strategy should not focus solely on whether the company lags in model development, but rather on whether Apple can leverage its huge existing user base to bring practical AI functions into everyday consumer life.
Ives estimates Apple has more than 2.5 billion active devices globally, including 1.5 billion iPhones, giving Apple a massive consumer channel that AI developers will find hard to replicate.

Apple’s strategy combines on‑device computing, personal context data, tight hardware‑software integration and privacy protection, making AI not just a standalone app but embedded across Apple products and services.
Ives describes Apple as a potential “toll booth on the consumer‑AI highway,” capturing commercial value as users employ AI through Apple’s devices, operating system and developer ecosystem.
This approach means Apple doesn’t need to lead in foundational model capability; as long as users keep using AI on Apple hardware, the company can profit from related services.
AI is expected to boost service revenue, with an estimated per‑share value of $75.
Through its massive device base, Apple can help developers reach more consumers and create new revenue streams within its existing service ecosystem.
Ives projects AI‑related revenue could account for more than 15% of Apple’s services revenue, a potential that Wall Street has not yet fully priced in.
He further estimates Apple’s AI vision and commercialization could add roughly $75 per share and support a $400 target price per share.
iPhone upgrade cycle and new devices add momentum to AI growth.
Ives estimates about 375 million iPhones are over four years old and have not been upgraded, representing a sizable replacement demand.
He also expects the upcoming iPhone Duo to sell around 10 million units in the next few quarters, with an optimistic scenario reaching about 15 million units by the holiday season.
Ives sees the Duo as Apple’s most significant new hardware innovation since the launch of AirPods, signaling a new hardware cycle under CEO John Ternus.
This creates a dual growth opportunity: AI features can enhance the value of existing devices, while longer‑life iPhones and the new foldable device could drive upgrades.

For investors, the key will be whether Apple can turn AI from a product feature into recurring service revenue; if Ives is right, Apple need not build the entire consumer‑AI highway, just capture the user entry point to keep profiting.

items.title: 資深分析師大幅上調美光目標價 看好未來3至5年潛力
items.title_en: Senior Analyst Raises Micron Target Price Sharply, Bullish on 3-5 Year Potential
paras: 《TheStreet》報導，美光科技(Micron Technology)(MU-US)投資人今年已經獲得相當可觀報酬。如今更棘手問題是，AI是否已從根本上改變這家公司的業務，使這波漲勢不再只是熟悉的記憶體景氣循環又一次走向高峰。
這是個非常龐大的問題。如果需求維持緊俏的時間是以「年」而不是「季」計算，而且美光能夠透過長期協議鎖定更多業務，那麼這家公司可能開始不再像一家高度波動的商品型生產商，而更像一家擁有持續獲利能力的企業。
D.A. Davidson資深分析師Gil Luria認為，市場仍低估了這項轉變。他表示，「美光未來3到5年都處於成長軌道，這正是市場目前還沒有充分認知到的。」
他的投資論點建立在AI經濟模式的一項簡單轉變上。他預期供需將出現重大失衡，同時也向投資人提出一個更大的問題：美光的獲利是否仍應被視為暫時性的。
Luria認為，AI實際上已經把記憶體從高度周期性的商品，轉變為AI基礎設施中「任務關鍵」的元件。
因此，Luria將美光目標價從2,100美元大幅上調至3,000美元，並重申「買進」評級。美光周四收盤下跌4.7%，至每股1,035.84美元。
他認為美光正處於一段為期3至5年的成長軌道，而投資人尚未完全將這項成長潛力反映在股價估值中。他預期，記憶體需求在2027年與2028年都將超過供給。
他表示，投資人「才剛開始理解美光的價值」，並認為這個過程最終應會帶來明顯更高的本益比。
簡單來說，美光的投資論點其實很直接：能力更強大的AI系統，需要龐大數量的快速記憶體。
Luria的報告指出，增加記憶體容量可支援更大的上下文視窗、更快的處理速度，以及更佳的AI效能。這將改變記憶體的經濟價值，因為如果周邊系統無法快速向處理器提供足夠資料，GPU和客製化加速器就無法充分發揮作用。
美光也一直在提出幾乎相同的論點。據《路透社》報導，美光總裁兼營運長Manish Bhatia近期表示，隨著資料中心成為全球最大的記憶體與儲存市場，「記憶體已成為AI的主要瓶頸」。
此外，據《TrendForce》報導，美光預期2027與2028會計年度的記憶體供需狀況，將比2026會計年度更加吃緊。
支持Luria投資論點的數字也相當可觀。美光2026會計年度第四季營收從前一年度同期的113.2億美元，大幅成長至542.3億美元，調整後每股盈餘(EPS)達33.42美元。2026會計年度全年營收達1,331.9億美元，調整後每股盈餘為75.52美元。
管理層同時預估第一季營收約為615億美元，高於華爾街預期的570.2億美元。更重要的是，長期供應承諾從220億美元增加至320億美元，而剩餘履約義務從1,000億美元攀升至約1,500億美元。
這些數字支持Luria的看法，即長期合約可能讓美光過去高度周期性的業務變得更加可預測。即使「降規」也未必代表利空，因為如果減少記憶體用量最終會損害AI效能，反而可能促使客戶未來購買更多記憶體。
paras_en: TheStreet reports that Micron Technology (MU-US) investors have already enjoyed substantial returns this year. The tougher question now is whether AI has fundamentally altered the company’s business, turning this rally into more than just another peak in the familiar memory cycle.

This is a massive issue. If demand remains tight for years rather than quarters, and Micron can lock in more business through long‑term agreements, the company may start to look less like a highly volatile commodity producer and more like a firm with sustainable earnings power.

D.A. Davidson senior analyst Gil Luria believes the market still underestimates this shift. He says, “Micron will be on a growth trajectory for the next three to five years, something the market has not yet fully recognized.”

His investment thesis rests on a simple change in the AI economic model. He expects a major supply‑demand imbalance and poses a bigger question to investors: should Micron’s earnings still be viewed as temporary?
Luria argues that AI has already turned memory from a highly cyclical commodity into a “mission‑critical” component of AI infrastructure.
Accordingly, Luria lifted Micron’s price target from $2,100 to $3,000 and reaffirmed a “Buy” rating. Micron closed Thursday down 4.7% at $1,035.84 per share.
He sees Micron on a three‑to‑five‑year growth path that investors have not yet fully reflected in the stock’s valuation, forecasting memory demand to outpace supply in both 2027 and 2028.
Luria says investors are “just beginning to understand Micron’s value” and believes this realization will eventually drive a noticeably higher P/E multiple.
In short, the investment case for Micron is straightforward: more powerful AI systems require massive amounts of fast memory.

Luria’s report notes that larger memory capacity supports bigger context windows, faster processing speeds, and better AI performance. This changes the economics of memory because if surrounding systems cannot feed processors quickly enough, GPUs and custom accelerators cannot operate at full capacity.

Micron has been making a nearly identical argument. Reuters reports that Micron President and COO Manish Bhatia recently said that as data centers become the world’s largest memory and storage market, “memory has become the primary bottleneck for AI.”
Additionally, TrendForce reports that Micron expects the memory supply‑demand balance in fiscal 2027 and 2028 to be tighter than in fiscal 2026.

The numbers backing Luria’s thesis are substantial. Micron’s Q4 FY2026 revenue jumped from $11.32 billion a year earlier to $54.23 billion, with adjusted EPS of $33.42. Full‑year FY2026 revenue reached $133.19 billion, with adjusted EPS of $75.52.

Management also forecasts Q1 revenue around $61.5 billion, above Wall Street’s $57.02 billion estimate. More importantly, long‑term supply commitments rose from $22 billion to $32 billion, while remaining performance obligations climbed from $100 billion to roughly $150 billion.

These figures support Luria’s view that long‑term contracts could make Micron’s historically cyclical business more predictable. Even “down‑spec” moves may not be negative, because reducing memory usage could hurt AI performance and may actually prompt customers to buy more memory in the future.

items.title: 木頭姐最新持倉曝！大賣Meta、超微、Alphabet  斥670萬美元加碼「這一股」
paras: 「木頭姐」伍德（Cathie Wood）旗下方舟投資（ARK Invest）最新交易動向出爐，週四（8日）同步調節多檔科技股，賣出SpaceX(SPCX-US) 、Meta(META-US) 、超微半導體(AMD-US) 及Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 股票，並加碼國防科技公司Kratos Defense & Security Solutions Inc(KTOS-US)。
根據《Benziga》報導，其中，方舟投資透過旗下ARK Next Generation Technology ETF(ARKW-US) 賣出29,048股SpaceX股票，以當日收盤價160.57美元計算，交易金額約470萬美元；透過ARK 創新 ETF(ARKK-US) 賣出19,779股Meta股票，價值約1,430萬美元。
此外，方舟投資也透過ARKK賣出22,500股超微半導體股票，交易金額接近1,400萬美元，並賣出25,342股Alphabet C類股，價值約870萬美元。
相較之下，Kratos成為當日加碼標的。方舟投資透過ARKK買進159,918股Kratos股票，以當日收盤價41.93美元計算，交易金額約670萬美元。

SpaceX布局行動通訊　收購頻譜擴大Starlink野心

SpaceX週四宣布，已與Grain Management達成協議，將收購該公司在全美持有的800 MHz頻譜組合，但未公布交易金額。
這項交易將進一步推進SpaceX擴大Starlink Mobile業務、成為美國主要無線電信業者的計畫。
SpaceX表示，低頻頻譜有助於訊號穿透牆壁及其他障礙物，提升通訊覆蓋能力，但相關部署仍須取得美國聯邦通信委員會（FCC）最終批准。
SpaceX執行長馬斯克形容這項協議是「非常重大的交易」。投資人評估SpaceX可能帶來的競爭威脅後，AT&T(T-US) 、威瑞森電信(VZ-US) 及T-Mobile(TMUS-US) 股價在盤後交易中下跌。

Meta押注個人AI代理　商業化仍面臨挑戰

Meta的AI布局也受到市場關注。花旗預估，Meta推出的個人AI代理Muse到2030年每年可創造超過270億美元營收，其中約230億美元來自交易，另有約45億美元來自訂閱服務。
Muse自9月8日推出後，下載量已突破660萬次，每日活躍用戶達180萬人。不過，亞馬遜決定禁止Muse在其購物網站使用，也凸顯AI代理進軍電子商務市場仍可能面臨阻礙。
Meta預估，2026年資本支出將達1,300億至1,450億美元，以持續擴建AI基礎設施。

超微半導體提前布局2027年產能　Alphabet加速企業AI競爭

超微半導體執行長蘇姿丰本周稍早表示，隨著未來數年AI需求強勁，公司計畫在2027年大幅增加晶片供應。
超微半導體正與富士康、台積電(2330-TW) 及記憶體供應商合作，確保中央處理器（CPU）、圖形處理器（GPU）、先進晶圓及記憶體的產能。蘇姿丰指出，公司目前已提前3至5年規劃產能。
超微半導體資料中心事業主管Forrest Norrod則看好Venice系列CPU的發展機會，認為隨著AI代理普及，資料處理及工具使用相關工作負載的需求將增加。
Alphabet方面，Google推出可整合Gmail、Drive、Docs及Calendar的Gemini代理，進一步拓展企業AI服務。該工具能回答問題、建立內容及撰寫程式碼，並提供成本控管、安全及治理功能，瞄準企業客戶需求。
此舉也使Google與OpenAI、Anthropic、微軟及亞馬遜在企業AI市場的競爭更加激烈。另一方面，投資機構TD Cowen週四將Alphabet目標價上調至485美元，維持「買進」評等。

Kratos營收年增逾3成　全年財測同步上修

在方舟投資加碼的標的中，Kratos的最新財務表現值得關注。
Kratos於8月公布第二季財報，營收達4.588億美元，高於市場預估的4.1038億美元；調整後每股盈餘為0.21美元，也優於市場預期的0.14美元。營收年增30.5%，未交訂單金額達20.8億美元，另有150億美元的投標與提案機會。
公司並將全年營收預測從原先的17億至17.6億美元，上調至17.5億至18.1億美元。
執行長Eric DeMarco表示，業務動能預計將於2026年下半年持續加快，並延續至2027年。

其他重要交易：買進Genius Sports、Klarna與Archer Aviation

除上述主要持股調整外，方舟投資週四也進行多筆交易：

買進Genius Sports (GENI-US) ：透過ARK Fintech Innovation ETF（ARKF）買進347,777股。
買進Klarna Group Plc(KLAR-US) ：透過ARKF買進135,914股。
賣出DraftKings公司(DKNG-US) ：透過ARKF賣出106,134股。
賣出ARK 21Shares Bitcoin ETF(ARKB-US) ：透過ARKF賣出66,454股。
賣出Robinhood Markets(HOOD-US) ：透過ARKK賣出202,825股。
賣出Shopify公司(SHOP-US) ：透過ARKK賣出138,032股。
加碼Archer Aviation(ACHR-US) ：ARKK、ARKQ及ARKX合計買進148,928股。

items.title: 史上最大重組月底上路！683家日企逐步從東證指數剔除  逾1兆美元被動資金面臨調整
items.title_en: Largest Reorganization in History Set for End of Month! 683 Japanese Companies Gradually Removed from TOPIX, Over $1 Trillion in Passive Funds Face Adjustments
paras: 日本交易所集團(JPX)周三(7日)公布東證股價指數(Topix)史上最大規模成分股重組，10月30日起生效。按新流動性與自由流通市值標準，683檔現有股票不符納入條件、35檔來自標準市場與成長市場的新股納入。若執行順利，Topix成分股將由8月底約1636檔、兩年內降至約986檔，較現有股數接近腰斬。
這是Topix改革第二階段。第一階段2025年1月已把成分股由約2200檔壓至約1700檔，此次進一步把「上市市場」篩選邏輯改為「交易活躍度＋自由流通市值」，現有公司須滿足年度換手率等流動性要求，並進入自由流通市值前97%。新納入者須進前96%。
未達上述標準者不會即日出局，指數權重按季遞減，至2028年7月降至零，若明年10月重評重新達標可中止減權，2028年10月起改為年度再平衡。
與此同時，被動資金規模使改革備受全球關注。大和證券首席量化橋本淳一上月預估，約166兆日元(1.1兆美元)追蹤Topix。另據瑞銀預估，約155兆日元(1兆美元)，JPX統計則約160兆日元。
被列入剔除名單者面臨指數基金分期減持，新納入如日本麥當勞、東映動畫、叫車平台GO等可獲被動買盤與主動基金關注，但瑞銀日股分析師小林千紗指出，被剔除公司佔家數約三分之一，但佔Topix總市值不到3%，對指數表現與整體流動性的直接衝擊有限，主要影響是个股層面而非大盤方向。
JPX改革目的在提升可投資性與逼出公司治理。近年，JPX社長山道裕己持續推資本效率、股東回報與披露標準；Amundi Japan股票投資主管石原博美認為，成分股縮減「基本正面」，企業須持續證明留指數合理性，若分紅、回購、ROE改善逐案累積，可抬升日股整體評價。部分小型股已提前增加股東回報來降低剔出風險，但主動基金仍要分辨「為保指數而派息」與「真改善治理」的差別。
結構上，JPX新規更重視自由流通市值，有利三菱日聯、豐田、軟銀等大型藍籌股。
高盛分析師Bruce Kirk認為，AI相關大型股指數影響力會再升，東海東京分析師三道翔太則稱小型股剔出風險持續、大盤趨勢可能加強。
短期看，被剔小股有被動賣壓與流動性折價，新納入股有建倉支撐；中長期看，Topix從「廣泛涵蓋全市場」轉向「流動性優先的核心池」，可投資度提升，但也會犧牲小型股、低成交公司的價格發現功能。對追蹤Topix的ETF與退休基金而言，未來兩年再平衡節奏比單日調整更關鍵。
paras_en: Japan Exchange Group (JPX) announced on Wednesday (the 7th) the biggest ever component reshuffle of the TOPIX index, effective October 30. Under the new liquidity and free‑float market‑cap criteria, 683 existing stocks fail the inclusion rules while 35 new stocks from the Standard and Growth markets will be added. If implemented smoothly, TOPIX constituents will drop from about 1,636 at the end of August to roughly 986 within two years, nearly halving the current count.

This is the second phase of the TOPIX reform. The first phase, completed in January 2025, reduced the number of constituents from roughly 2,200 to about 1,700. The current phase changes the "listing market" screening logic to "trading activity + free‑float market cap"; existing companies must meet annual turnover‑rate liquidity requirements and rank within the top 97% of free‑float market cap, while newcomers must rank within the top 96%.

Companies that do not meet the new standards will not be removed immediately; their index weight will be phased down quarterly, reaching zero by July 2028. If they regain compliance in the October review next year, the weight reduction can be halted, and from October 2028 the index will be rebalanced annually.

At the same time, the massive scale of passive capital has drawn global attention to the reform. Daiwa Securities’ chief quant Junichi Hashimoto estimated last month that about ¥166 trillion (US$1.1 trillion) tracks TOPIX. UBS estimates around ¥155 trillion (US$1 trillion), while JPX’s own data put the figure at roughly ¥160 trillion.

Those placed on the removal list will face staged sell‑downs by index funds. New entrants such as McDonald’s Japan, Toei Animation and ride‑hailing platform GO can attract passive buying and active‑fund interest, but UBS Japan‑equity analyst Chisa Kobayashi notes that the companies slated for removal represent about one‑third of the number of constituents yet account for less than 3% of TOPIX’s total market value, so the direct impact on index performance and overall liquidity is limited, affecting mainly individual stocks rather than the market direction.

JPX’s reform aims to improve investability and push better corporate governance. In recent years, JPX President Hiroki Yamaguchi has promoted capital efficiency, shareholder returns and disclosure standards; Amundi Japan equity head Hiromi Ishihara sees the reduction of constituents as "basically positive," arguing that companies will need to continuously prove their relevance to the index, and that incremental improvements in dividends, buybacks and ROE can lift the overall valuation of Japanese equities. Some small‑cap stocks have already increased shareholder returns to lower their exclusion risk, but active managers must still differentiate between "dividends paid just to stay in the index" and genuine governance improvements.
Structurally, the new JPX rules place greater emphasis on free‑float market cap, benefiting large blue‑chip stocks such as Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group, Toyota and SoftBank.

Goldman Sachs analyst Bruce Kirk believes AI‑related large‑cap stocks will gain even more influence in the index, while Tokai Tokyo analyst Shota Sando says the risk of small‑cap removals persists and could reinforce broader market trends.

In the short term, the removed small caps may face passive selling pressure and liquidity discounts, while the newly added stocks could receive buying support. Over the medium to long term, TOPIX will shift from a "broad market‑covering" index to a "liquidity‑first core pool," enhancing investability but sacrificing price‑discovery for small‑cap and low‑turnover stocks. For TOPIX‑tracking ETFs and pension funds, the rebalancing cadence over the next two years will be more critical than any single‑day adjustment.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元走弱 歐洲公債殖利率自高點回落
items.title_en: <NY Forex> Dollar Weakens, European Government Bond Yields Retreat from Peaks
paras: 美元周四(8日)走弱，歐元區公債殖利率的升勢暫歇，而市場對聯準會(Fed)今年利率走向的預期大致維持不變。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.08%，報102.17，此前一度升至102.46。
歐元兌美元上漲0.08%，至1.1204美元，盤中一度跌至1.1171美元。
歐元區政府公債殖利率再度大幅上升，油價飆漲加劇通膨疑慮，投資人持續拋售法國、義大利等高負債國家的公債。
不過，隨著殖利率升勢逐漸降溫，歐元也從盤中低點回升。法國10年期公債殖利率上升2.7個基點至4.8873%，盤中一度攀升至4.9685%。
在投資人密切檢視法國的債務規模、預算赤字，以及2027年總統大選前的政治前景之際，法國受到的衝擊尤其明顯。
西班牙方面，工會周三宣布將於11月11日發動全國性總罷工，抗議住宅問題，而這場示威距離提前舉行的大選僅剩數周。
Fed釋放升息謹慎訊號
市場對聯準會本月稍晚政策會議升息的預期仍偏低。聯準會周三公布最新一次會議紀要後，顯示決策官員認為通膨是經濟展望面臨的最大風險，分析師則表示，會議紀要並未帶來意外訊號。
聯準會理事華勒(Christopher Waller)周四表示，為了讓通膨降至聯準會2%的目標，未來可能仍需要進一步升息，但他也表示升息步調具「彈性」，並為即將舉行的10月會議暫停升息留下空間。
華勒的言論呼應了部分聯準會官員上周的說法，他們均釋放出希望在進一步升息上保持耐心的訊號。
SimCorp多資產投資決策研究主管Christoph Schon表示，「多數其他貨幣似乎都與其貨幣政策預期呈反向關係，但那是因為過去一切都受到美元和聯準會主導，而這種情況在過去幾周仍持續存在。」
「有趣的是，現在還有另一個影響歐元的因素，也就是法國、如今甚至西班牙的政治危機……因此，這是一段短暫的時期，焦點不在利率差或貨幣政策，而是一場非常特殊的歐元危機，而在這個案例中，它正影響歐元。」
市場押注12月升息
根據CME FedWatch工具，市場目前預期聯準會本月升息至少25個基點的機率僅17.2%，略低於一周前的24.4%。不過，投資人押注12月會議升息的機率則達到81.2%。
在華勒發表上述評論後，高盛分析師在報告中表示，他們仍預期聯準會12月將再升息25個基點，並下調12月不升息的機率，因為華勒的言論代表政策立場轉向更加鷹派。
在更為鷹派的談話中，聖路易聯準銀行總裁穆薩林(Alberto Musalem)表示，美國央行需要再次升息，才能讓通膨回到2%的目標。
經濟數據方面，美國勞工部表示，上周初領失業金人數減少2,000人至19.7萬人，略低於《路透社》調查經濟學家預估的20萬人。最新數據持續顯示美國就業市場保持穩定。
歐元區通膨可能高於目前已經偏高的預測，但歐洲央行(ECB)決策官員壓低了市場對短期升息的押注，多名官員周四表示，從基本面趨勢來看，情況其實較為溫和。
德國公債與法國、義大利等歐元區高負債國家公債之間不斷擴大的殖利率差距，已推動歐元跌至2024年5月以來最低水準。
英鎊兌美元上漲0.07%至1.3219美元，此前英國央行(BoE)總裁Andrew Bailey表示，全球債券市場受到高額借貸與不斷升高的通膨壓力衝擊之際，各國政府需要加倍努力，展現修復公共財政的能力。
美元兌日元下跌0.12%至157.88日元。日本銀行(BoJ)表示，原物料成本上升所帶動的價格漲勢正蔓延至消費品，部分企業提高價格的頻率也有所增加，顯示日銀對通膨壓力擴大的情況感到擔憂。

paras_en: The dollar weakened on Thursday (the 8th), pausing the rise in Eurozone government bond yields, while market expectations for the Fed's rate path this year remained largely unchanged.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the dollar against six major currencies, fell 0.08% to 102.17 after briefly climbing to 102.46.
The euro rose 0.08% against the dollar to $1.1204, after dipping intraday to $1.1171.
Eurozone sovereign yields surged again as oil price spikes heightened inflation concerns, prompting investors to continue selling bonds of heavily indebted countries such as France and Italy.
However, as the yield rally cooled, the euro recovered from its intraday low. France's 10‑year yield rose 2.7 basis points to 4.8873%, briefly reaching 4.9685% during the session.
The impact on France was especially pronounced as investors closely examined its debt size, budget deficit, and political outlook ahead of the 2027 presidential election.
In Spain, unions announced on Wednesday a nationwide general strike on November 11 to protest housing issues, a protest taking place only weeks before an early election.
Fed signals cautious rate‑hike stance

Market expectations for a rate hike at the Fed's later policy meeting this month remain low. After the Fed released minutes of its latest meeting on Wednesday, officials said inflation remains the biggest risk to the economic outlook, and analysts said the minutes offered no surprise signals.

Fed Governor Christopher Waller said on Thursday that further rate hikes may still be needed to bring inflation down to the Fed's 2% target, but he also noted that the pace of hikes is “flexible,” leaving room to pause at the upcoming October meeting.
Waller's comments echoed remarks from other Fed officials last week, who all signaled a desire to be patient on any further tightening.

Christoph Schon, head of multi‑asset investment decision research at SimCorp, said, “Most other currencies seem to move opposite to their monetary‑policy expectations, but that’s because everything has been dominated by the dollar and the Fed, and that situation has persisted over the past few weeks.”

“Interestingly, there is now another factor affecting the euro – the political crises in France and now even Spain… So this is a short‑term episode where the focus is not on rate differentials or policy, but on a very specific euro crisis that is currently influencing the currency,” he added.
Markets bet on a December hike

According to the CME FedWatch tool, the market currently assigns a 17.2% probability that the Fed will raise rates by at least 25 basis points this month, down slightly from 24.4% a week ago. However, investors see an 81.2% chance of a hike at the December meeting.

After Waller’s remarks, a Goldman Sachs analyst wrote that they still expect a 25‑basis‑point hike in December and lowered the probability of no hike, interpreting Waller’s comments as a shift toward a more hawkish stance.
In an even more hawkish tone, Alberto Musalem, president of St. Louis Federal Reserve Bank, said the U.S. central bank needs another rate increase to bring inflation back to the 2% target.

On the data front, the U.S. Labor Department reported that initial unemployment claims fell by 2,000 to 197,000 last week, slightly below the Reuters poll forecast of 200,000, indicating the labor market remains stable.

Eurozone inflation may be higher than already elevated forecasts, but ECB policymakers have dampened market bets on a near‑term hike, with several officials on Thursday noting that, based on fundamentals, the situation is actually fairly moderate.
The widening yield gap between German bonds and those of high‑debt Eurozone members such as France and Italy has pushed the euro down to its lowest level since May 2024.

The pound rose 0.07% to $1.3219 after Bank of England Governor Andrew Bailey said that as global bond markets face high borrowing and rising inflation pressures, governments need to work harder to demonstrate fiscal repair capability.

The dollar fell 0.12% to ¥157.88. The Bank of Japan said rising raw‑material costs are feeding price increases into consumer goods, with some firms raising prices more frequently, showing the BOJ’s concern over expanding inflation pressures.

paras: 隨著美債殖利率上揚，台北股匯市今(8)日同步回檔，新台幣雖早盤一度升值，但走貶壓力大增，終場收在31.875元，貶值8分，台北外匯經紀公司成交值暴增至25.03億美元。
新台幣今日以31.82元、貶值2.5分開出後，最高一度來到31.78元，午盤過後越走越低，最低見到31.94元，全日高低價差1.6角。
觀察主要亞幣，韓元重挫超過0.3%，新台幣收貶0.25%，星元貶近0.2%，泰銖和日元貶0.1%上下，人民幣處平盤附近波動，而美元指數續彈0.15%上下。
元大投顧分析，10年期美債殖利率攀升至 2002 年以來高點，FOMC會議紀要釋放年內仍有升息可能，使市場風險偏好遭到壓抑。
國泰證期研究部表示，受中東戰事推升布蘭特原油站上100 美元影響，通膨疑慮再起，並引發債市拋售，下周財報季市場也緊盯 AI 支出效益和消費者健康。
paras_en: As U.S. Treasury yields rose, Taipei's stock and foreign exchange markets retreated in tandem today (the 8th). The New Taiwan dollar briefly appreciated in early trading but faced increasing depreciation pressure, ending at 31.875, down 0.08. The turnover of Taipei foreign exchange brokers surged to US$2.503 billion.
The New Taiwan dollar opened at 31.82, down 0.025, then rose to a high of 31.78, but after the midday session it kept falling, reaching a low of 31.94; the intraday range was 0.16 TWD.

Looking at other major Asian currencies, the Korean won fell more than 0.3%, the New Taiwan dollar slipped 0.25%, the Singapore dollar dropped about 0.2%, the Thai baht and Japanese yen each moved around 0.1% lower, the Chinese yuan hovered near flat, while the US dollar index continued to bounce around 0.15%.

Yuanta Securities Investment Advisory notes that the 10-year U.S. Treasury yield has climbed to its highest level since 2002, and the FOMC meeting minutes suggest there is still a possibility of a rate hike this year, suppressing market risk appetite.

Cathay Securities Research says that Middle East conflicts have pushed Brent crude above US$100, reviving inflation concerns and triggering bond-market selling. Next week’s earnings season will also see the market closely watching AI spending efficiency and consumer health.

items.title: 【遠東商銀】FED升息理由分岐，美元升勢受阻
items.title_en: Far East Commercial Bank: Fed Rate‑Hike Rationale Divides, Dollar Gains Stalled
paras: ◆USD/JPY

美國8月貿易逆差擴大幅度超過預期至十七個月最高，料將在第三季再次拖累經濟，但美國舊金山聯邦儲備銀行總裁戴利與堪薩斯城聯邦儲備銀行總裁施密特均主張美國聯邦準備理事會(FED)進一步上調政策利率以降低不斷上升的通貨膨脹風險，並據紐約聯邦儲備銀行報告顯示9月供應鏈壓力升溫，可能推動通貨膨脹率上升，而且美國總統川普盛讚強勢美元，表明美國經濟表現良好，週四推升美元兌日圓至158.50高點，但共同社報導，日本央行(BOJ)鴿派審議委員佐藤綾野表示，鑒於當前金融環境較為寬鬆，支持以分階段的方式升息，並據路透短觀調查，日本10月非製造業景氣判斷指數降至正23，但製造業景氣判斷指數升至2021年12月以來最高達正22，而且日本數據顯示，9月底外匯儲備降至1.18億美元，但8月實質薪資較上年同期增長1.5%，為連續第八個月上漲，限制日圓走貶。

隨後據紐約聯邦儲備銀行調查，美國公眾未來一年通貨膨脹預期升至2023年5月以來最高，但家庭在9月下調當前及未來財務狀況評估，並據美國聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)發布9月會議紀錄，FED決策者對當月升息是預防性措施或對貨幣政策轉向大幅收緊而抑制投資和支出存在分歧，而且芝加哥商業交易所(CME)的FedWatch工具顯示市場預計FED在12月會議加息的機率為83%，但本月會議至少加息25個基點的概率降至19.4%，打壓美元兌日圓至157.83低點。預估今日美元兌日圓阻力於158.00-20，支撐於157.00-20。
◆EUR/USD
全球債券市場拋售暫歇，提振風險偏好，但昨日中國數據顯示9月外匯儲備較前月減少380.7億美元，規模創六個月新低，而且FED會議紀錄公布前賣盤湧現，導致澳幣及紐元承壓，並隨著西班牙宣布提前舉行大選，拖累歐元兌美元受限於1.1264高點。

隨著德國上半年出口意外強勁，德國外貿協會(BGA)將今年出口增長預期上調至1%，並據德國聯邦統計局表示，受建築業產出增長推動，8月德國工業生產較前月升2.0%超出預期，而且法國央行(BOF)總裁穆蘭稱，法國的經濟形勢嚴峻，但現階段無需尋求歐洲央行(ECB)介入，惟市場擔憂法國財政狀況不斷惡化及明年可能導致嚴重分岐的總統選舉，而且油價上漲和歐洲公債收益率攀升，削弱對歐元的信心，推動歐元兌美元跌至1.1164低點價位。預估今日歐元兌美元阻力於1.1200-20，支撐於1.1110-30。
◆GBP/USD

週三萊斯銀行集團公布英國9月房屋價格較前月與上年同期均持平，但皆不及預期，並按季度計算，房屋價格下跌0.2%，而且8月錄得2023年以來首次較去年同期下跌，打擊英鎊兌美元自1.3275高點下跌。隨著美國公債收益率在FED會議紀錄公布前重拾升勢及美圓普遍走強，而且市場聚焦英國10月28日的首份預算案，擴大英鎊兌美元跌幅至1.3190低點價位。預估今日英鎊兌美元阻力於1.3210-30，支撐於1.3110-30。

paras_en: USD/JPY

U.S. August trade deficit widened more than expected to a 17‑month high, likely dragging the economy again in Q3. Both San Francisco Fed President Mary Daly and Kansas City Fed President Jeff Schmid argue the Fed should raise policy rates further to curb rising inflation risk. A New York Fed report shows September supply‑chain pressure heating up, which could push inflation higher. President Trump praised a strong dollar, indicating solid U.S. economic performance, and on Thursday lifted the dollar‑yen to a 158.50 peak. However, Kyodo reports that BOJ dovish committee member Ayano Sato said the current relatively loose financial environment supports a step‑by‑step rate‑hike approach. Reuters short‑term survey shows Japan’s October non‑manufacturing business confidence index fell to +23, while the manufacturing index rose to +22 – the highest since December 2021. Japanese data also show foreign‑exchange reserves fell to $118 billion at end‑September, but August real wages rose 1.5% year‑on‑year for the eighth consecutive month, limiting yen depreciation.

According to a New York Fed survey, U.S. public inflation expectations for the next year rose to the highest since May 2023, while households downgraded their current and future financial‑condition assessments in September. The September FOMC minutes reveal a split among Fed officials over whether the month’s rate hike was a preventive move or a pre‑emptive tightening that could curb investment and spending. CME’s FedWatch tool shows an 83% probability of a rate increase at the December meeting, but the odds of at least a 25‑basis‑point hike at the September meeting fell to 19.4%, pulling the dollar‑yen down to a 157.83 low. The dollar‑yen is expected to face resistance around 158.00‑158.20 and support near 157.00‑157.20 today.
EUR/USD

Global bond‑market selling paused, boosting risk appetite, but Chinese data released yesterday showed September foreign‑exchange reserves fell by $38.07 billion from the prior month, a six‑month low. Ahead of the Fed minutes release, sell‑offs pressured the Australian and New Zealand dollars, and Spain’s decision to call an early election weighed on the euro, capping it near the 1.1264 high.

Germany’s first‑half export surprise led the German Foreign Trade Association (BGA) to raise its full‑year export growth outlook to 1%. The German Federal Statistics Office reported that, driven by a rebound in construction output, August industrial production rose 2.0% month‑on‑month, beating expectations. Meanwhile, Banque de France Governor François Villeroy de Galhau said France’s economic situation is severe but does not yet require ECB intervention. Markets remain worried about France’s fiscal deterioration and a potentially polarising presidential election next year. Rising oil prices and climbing European sovereign‑bond yields have eroded confidence in the euro, pushing EUR/USD down to a 1.1164 low. EUR/USD is expected to face resistance around 1.1200‑1.1220 and support near 1.1110‑1.1130 today.
GBP/USD

Wednesday Lloyds Banking Group reported that UK September house prices were flat month‑on‑month and year‑on‑year, both missing expectations. On a quarterly basis, prices fell 0.2%, and August recorded the first year‑on‑year decline since 2023, hurting the pound from its 1.3275 peak. As U.S. Treasury yields rose again before the Fed minutes and the dollar stayed strong, market focus on the UK’s first budget on October 28 widened the pound’s drop to a 1.3190 low. GBP/USD is expected to face resistance around 1.3210‑1.3230 and support near 1.3110‑1.3130 today.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元創近18個月新高 Fed會議紀要指今年可能再升息
items.title_en: New York Forex Market: Dollar Hits Near 18-Month High; Fed Minutes Suggest Possible Further Rate Hike This Year
paras: 美元周三(7日) 走強，升至近18個月高點，受到聯準會(Fed)會議紀要顯示可能進一步升息，以及歐元與英鎊走弱雙重支撐。歐元與英鎊受到全球債券拋售潮再度升溫拖累，承受下行壓力。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.4%，報102.24，盤中一度觸及2025年4月9日以來最高。
外匯市場參與者周三關注聯準會9月貨幣政策會議紀要。紀要顯示，多數聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)官員認為，今年年底前還可能再升息一次。
FOMC上個月一致投票決定將聯邦資金利率上調25個基點，為3年多來首次升息。同時，FOMC更新後的點陣圖也暗示今年還可能進一步升息。聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)則在會後記者會上表示，讓通膨回落至央行2%的目標，仍是一項重大挑戰。
會議紀要指出，「關於本次會議之後的貨幣政策前景，多數與會者認為，在今年年底前進一步上調聯邦資金利率目標區間可能是適當的。」
紀要也顯示，所有FOMC官員都支持9月升息。
不過，這份紀要公布之際，市場對FOMC本月底再次升息的預期已較9月升息後大幅下降，主要受到近期部分官員偏鴿派的談話，以及美國經濟成長、通膨與勞動市場數據的影響。
根據CME FedWatch工具，目前市場預期本月底維持利率不變的機率接近83%，高於一個月前約54%的水準。
歐元受法國財政危機拖累
美元走強另一助力是歐元周三走跌。歐元兌美元下跌0.6%，至1歐元兌1.1195美元。
隨著法國財政危機惡化，以及西班牙政治陷入僵局，歐洲大陸的市場風險情緒承受壓力。法國10年期公債殖利率已升至2000年初以來未見高點。
法國今年財政赤字預計將達國內生產毛額(GDP)的5.4%，公共債務則接近GDP的120%。
法國政府上周公布2027年預算案，目標透過削減540億歐元的支出，將財政赤字目標控制在GDP的5%。
同時，法國在明年4月與5月舉行兩輪選舉前，也面臨政治不確定性。總統大選領先者、極右派政黨國民聯盟(National Rally)候選人勒龐，以及該黨黨魁Jordan Bardella周二公布主要預算方案，目標在2032年前節省1,400億歐元。
英鎊走弱 英國30年期公債殖利率創1998年來新高
全球債券拋售潮周三蔓延至英國，英國30年期公債殖利率升至1998年1月以來最高水準。
就在一天前，英國財政大臣John Healey才與英國公債市場的主要交易商會面，即所謂的金邊債券造市者(Gilt-edged Market Makers, GEMMs)。
英國財政部表示，與會者討論了英國與全球經濟所面臨的嚴峻外部環境，包括地緣政治發展與金融市場狀況。

paras_en: The dollar strengthened on Wednesday (the 7th), rising to a near 18‑month high, buoyed by Fed meeting minutes that indicated a possible further rate hike and by the weakness of the euro and pound. The euro and pound were pressured by a renewed wave of global bond sell‑offs, bearing downward pressure.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the dollar against six major currencies, rose 0.4% to 102.24, briefly touching its highest level since April 9, 2025.

Forex market participants on Wednesday focused on the Fed’s September monetary policy meeting minutes. The minutes showed that most Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) members think another rate hike could still be possible before the end of the year.

Last month the FOMC voted unanimously to raise the federal funds rate by 25 basis points, the first hike in more than three years. At the same time, the updated FOMC dot‑plot also hinted at the possibility of further hikes this year. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh said in the post‑meeting press conference that bringing inflation down to the central bank’s 2% target remains a major challenge.

The minutes noted, “Regarding the monetary policy outlook after this meeting, most participants believe that a further increase in the target range for the federal funds rate may be appropriate before the end of this year.”
The minutes also showed that all FOMC members supported a September rate hike.

However, as the minutes were released, market expectations for another FOMC hike at the end of the month had fallen sharply from after the September hike, mainly due to recent dovish remarks by some officials and the impact of U.S. economic growth, inflation and labor market data.
According to the CME FedWatch tool, the market now sees an almost 83% probability that rates will remain unchanged at the end of the month, up from about 54% a month ago.
Euro weighed down by France’s fiscal crisis
Another boost to the dollar’s strength was the euro’s decline on Wednesday. The euro fell 0.6% against the dollar to $1.1195 per euro.

As France’s fiscal crisis deepens and Spain’s politics stall, market risk sentiment across the continent is under pressure. France’s 10‑year government bond yield has risen to its highest level since early 2000.
France’s fiscal deficit this year is projected to reach 5.4% of GDP, with public debt close to 120% of GDP.
The French government unveiled its 2027 budget last week, aiming to cut €54 billion in spending and keep the fiscal deficit target at 5% of GDP.

At the same time, France faces political uncertainty ahead of two rounds of elections in April and May next year. National Rally leader Jordan Bardella, the party’s frontrunner in the presidential race, announced on Tuesday a major budget plan targeting €140 billion in savings by 2032.
Pound weakens as UK 30‑year gilt yield hits a 1998 high
A global bond sell‑off on Wednesday spread to the UK, pushing the 30‑year gilt yield to its highest level since January 1998.
Just a day earlier, UK Treasury Secretary John Healey met with the main dealers in the gilt market, the so‑called Gilt‑edged Market Makers (GEMMs).
The Treasury said the meeting discussed the severe external environment facing the UK and global economies, including geopolitical developments and financial market conditions.
The pound fell 0.5% against the dollar to $1.3213 per pound.

觀察主要亞幣，由於美元指數強彈達0.4%，非美貨幣全面走弱，泰銖貶0.4%，星元貶逾0.2%，日元和人民幣貶0.1%左右，新台幣收貶0.04%。
統一投顧分析，儘管市場聚焦中東情勢發展，並關注本周聯準會將發布9月會議記錄，不過，IEA宣布釋放1億桶戰略儲油，短線有助油價趨向穩定。

paras: 美元周二(6日)走弱，從近18個月高點回落。隨著歐元反彈，加上美國公債遭拋售的壓力有所緩解，美元漲勢暫歇。

歐元受到歐洲公債殖利率趨於穩定帶動。法國總統大選主要候選人之一、極右派「國民聯盟」領袖雷朋(Marine Le Pen)承諾，如果當選將大幅削減政府支出。此外，歐洲央行(ECB)一名官員也發表較為正面的談話，進一步支撐歐元。

法國10年期公債殖利率近期已升至2000年代初期以來未見水準，原因是該國面臨嚴重的財政與債務危機。法國10年期公債與德國聯邦公債之間的利差，也擴大至2012年歐元區債務危機以來的最大。
法國今年財政赤字預估將達國內生產毛額(GDP)的5.4%，公共債務占GDP比重則逼近120%。法國現任政府上周公布2027年預算案，計劃透過削減540億歐元(約607.9億美元)政府支出，將財政赤字控制在GDP的5%。
不過，法國也正面臨政治不確定性，明年4月與5月將舉行兩輪總統大選。
領先候選人、極右派領袖雷朋，以及該黨黨魁Jordan Bardella周二公布主要預算政策主張。

市場對油價推升通膨衝擊的擔憂、企業為建設AI基礎設施而大量發債的疑慮、各國央行偏向鷹派的貨幣政策，以及不斷膨脹的政府債務，都加劇了近期美國公債遭拋售的壓力。

paras_en: The dollar weakened on Tuesday (the 6th), retreating from an 18‑month high. With the euro rebounding and pressure on US Treasury sales easing, the dollar's rally paused.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, fell 0.3% to 101.86 points, still hovering near its highest level since April 9, 2025.

The euro was buoyed by stabilising European sovereign yields. One of the main candidates in the French presidential race, far‑right National Rally leader Marine Le Pen, pledged to slash government spending dramatically if elected. In addition, an ECB official made relatively positive remarks, further supporting the euro.
The euro rose 0.3% against the dollar to $1.1259, breaking a recent string of declines. Previously, turbulence in the French bond market had put pressure on the euro.

France's 10‑year government bond yield has recently climbed to levels not seen since the early 2000s, driven by a severe fiscal and debt crisis. The spread between French 10‑year yields and German Bunds has also widened to its widest since the 2012 euro‑zone debt crisis.

France's fiscal deficit this year is projected at 5.4% of GDP, with public debt approaching 120% of GDP. The incumbent French government unveiled its 2027 budget last week, planning to cut €54 billion (about $60.79 billion) in spending to keep the deficit at 5% of GDP.
However, France also faces political uncertainty, with two rounds of the presidential election scheduled for April and May next year.
Leading candidate and far‑right leader Le Pen, together with party chief Jordan Bardella, announced their main budget policy proposals on Tuesday.

The euro also received a lift from comments by ECB chief economist Philip Lane. Lane said that while energy prices in the euro area remain high, they have not yet triggered a strong second‑round inflation effect. In an interview with Italy's ANSA on Tuesday, Lane stressed that the extent to which higher energy costs will feed through to overall prices remains highly uncertain.
Dollar rally pauses as Treasury buying returns.
With US Treasury yields falling, the dollar's advance has temporarily stalled.
The 10‑year US Treasury yield dropped 3.5 basis points to 5.278%, while the 30‑year yield slipped slightly to 5.661%. Both had recently risen to their highest levels since early 2002.

Market worries about oil‑driven inflation, corporations issuing large amounts of debt to build AI infrastructure, hawkish monetary policies from central banks, and ever‑growing sovereign debt have all intensified recent pressure on US Treasuries.
France's political and fiscal turmoil has further deepened market unease.
Even though expectations that the Federal Reserve will tighten policy have eased, the dollar remains at relatively elevated levels.
Recent inflation and employment data suggest the Fed may have some breathing room to keep rates unchanged for now.
When asked about the dollar’s strength against the euro, US President Donald Trump said it was because the United States "is performing well" and claimed a strong dollar "won’t cause inflation".
